ilsp.query: Betrifft: Finanzielle Unterstützung für die von den Molukken-Inseln vertriebene christliche Bevölkerung Ein besonders dringliches Problem sind die Verfolgungen, Gewalttätigkeiten und Terrorakte gegen die christliche Bevölkerung auf den Molukken-Inseln, einem indonesischen Archipel, vor allem jene Gewalttaten von Jihad-Aktivisten auf der Insel Ambon, die Kirchen geschändet und in Brand gesteckt und die Christen vertrieben haben, nachdem sie viele von ihnen getötet hatten.
ilsp.judge: Subject: Financial support for the Christian population displaced from the Moluccas Islands A particularly urgent problem is the persecution, violence and terrorist acts against the Christian population on the Moluccas Islands, an Indonesian archipelago, especially those acts of Jihad activists on the island of Ambon, who have desecrated and set fire to churches and have driven out the Christians after they had killed many of them.
ilsp.proxy: Regarding financial support for the Christian population displaced from the Maluku Islands: One particularly urgent issue are the persecutions, violence, and terrorist acts against the Christian population on the Maluku Islands, an Indonesian archipelago, especially those violent acts by Jihad activists on the island of Ambon, who desecrated and set churches on fire, driving Christians away after killing many of them.

ilsp.query: Heute Nachmittag habe ich erfahren, dass zehn Mitglieder der Umweltorganisation Greenpeace, zehn pazifistische Umweltschützer, durch die Militärbehörde von La Roca auf Gibraltar festgenommen wurden, weil sie versucht hatten, sich dem U-Boot "Tireless " mit einem Spruchband zu nähern, um etwas zum Ausdruck zu bringen, was meiner Meinung nach alle Welt denkt, nämlich dass das Meer nicht durch Nuklearenergie in Beschlag genommen werden darf.
ilsp.judge: This afternoon I learned that ten members of the environmental organization Greenpeace, ten pacifist environmentalists, were arrested by the military authorities of La Roca in Gibraltar because they had tried to approach the submarine "Tireless" with a slogan to express something that, in my opinion, everyone thinks, namely that the sea must not be taken over by nuclear energy.
ilsp.proxy: Today afternoon, I learned that ten members of the environmental organization Greenpeace, ten pacifistic environmental protectors, were arrested by the military authority of La Roca on Gibraltar because they had tried to approach the submarine "Tireless" with a banner to express something that, in my opinion, everyone in the world thinks, namely that the sea must not be occupied by nuclear energy.
ilsp.reference: This afternoon, I learned that ten members of the environmental organization Greenpeace, ten pacifist environmentalists, were arrested by the military authorities in La Roca on Gibraltar, because they had attempted to approach the submarine "Tireless" with a banner, in order to express something that, in my opinion, everyone thinks, namely that the sea must not be taken over by nuclear energy.

ilsp.query: Diese Umweltschützer sind immer noch in Haft und da das Parlament bei der Wahrung der Interessen der Bewohner von Campo de Gibraltar und der Bucht von Algeciras - um es einmal so zu sagen - wenig Sensibilität gezeigt hat, bitte ich darum, dass man wenigstens geeignete Maßnahmen ergreift, damit diese pazifistischen Umweltschützer zu Hause schlafen können.
ilsp.judge: These environmentalists are still in custody and since the Parliament has shown little sensitivity in safeguarding the interests of the residents of Campo de Gibraltar and the Bay of Algeciras - to put it that way - I ask that at least appropriate measures be taken so that these pacifist environmentalists can sleep at home.

ilsp.query: Im Hinblick auf meinen Bericht möchte ich Folgendes hervorheben: Zunächst, Herr Kommissar, muss das Fischereiwesen in der Europäischen Union langsam diese nahezu innerstaatliche oder marginale Betrachtungsweise ablegen; es gibt sie gegenwärtig vielleicht aufgrund der Tatsache, dass sich die Fischerei auf Randgebiete beschränkt, oder aufgrund der Nüchternheit der Zahlen, wenn von ihrem Beitrag zum BIP der Gemeinschaft die Rede ist.
ilsp.judge: With regard to my report, I would like to highlight the following: First, Commissioner, the fisheries sector in the European Union must slowly shed this almost intra-state or marginal view; it currently exists perhaps due to the fact that fishing is limited to peripheral areas, or due to the sobriety of the numbers when the contribution of the sector to the GDP of the Community is mentioned.
ilsp.proxy: With regard to my report, I would like to highlight the following: First, Commissioner, the fishing industry in the European Union must gradually abandon this almost state-specific or marginal way of thinking; it may currently exist perhaps due to the fact that fishing is confined to peripheral areas, or due to the sobering nature of the numbers when discussing its contribution to the community's GDP.
ilsp.reference: In the context of my report, I would like to highlight the following: Firstly, Commissioner, the fishing industry in the European Union must gradually move away from this almost domestic or marginal way of looking at things; it currently exists perhaps due to the fact that fishing is limited to peripheral areas, or due to the sobriety of the numbers when it comes to its contribution to the EU's GDP.

ilsp.query: Ich bekräftige erneut meine Forderung, wie ich es in der Vergangenheit so häufig getan habe, dass zur Gewährleistung einer angemessenen Dezentralisierungspolitik der Zugang zu den Küstengewässern innerhalb der 12-Meilen-Zone weiterhin ausschließlich den Anrainerstaaten vorbehalten bleiben muss und dass diese ausschließliche Fischereizone auf 24 Seemeilen ausgedehnt wird, wie es dieses Haus im Februar 1999 gefordert hat.
ilsp.judge: I reiterate my demand, as I have so often done in the past, that in order to ensure an appropriate decentralization policy, access to coastal waters within the 12-mile zone must remain exclusively for coastal states and that this exclusive fishing zone is extended to 24 nautical miles, as this House demanded in February 1999.
ilsp.proxy: I reiterate my demand, as I have done in the past, that access to coastal waters within the 12-mile zone must remain exclusively reserved for the coastal states to ensure an appropriate decentralization policy, and that this exclusive fishing zone be extended to 24 nautical miles, as this House demanded in February 1999.
ilsp.reference: I reiterate my demand, as I have done so frequently in the past, that to ensure an appropriate policy of decentralization, access to coastal waters within the 12-mile zone must remain exclusively reserved for coastal states and that this exclusive fishing zone be extended to 24 nautical miles, as this House demanded in February 1999.

ilsp.query: Die Kommission stellt auf der Grundlage eines von der Regierung Guinea-Bissaus vorgelegten Aktionsprogramms 50 % der vorgesehenen finanziellen Gegenleistung zur Verfügung und zahlt die restlichen Mittel aus, sobald die Regierung dieses Landes einen detaillierten Bericht über die Durchführung der geplanten Maßnahmen und die hierbei erzielten Ergebnisse vorgelegt hat.
ilsp.judge: The Commission makes available 50% of the envisaged financial counterpart based on an action programme submitted by the Government of Guinea-Bissau and pays the remaining funds once the Government of this country has submitted a detailed report on the implementation of the planned measures and the results achieved.
ilsp.proxy: The Commission makes available 50% of the envisaged financial counterpart based on an action program presented by the Government of Guinea-Bissau and pays the remaining funds once the Government of this country submits a detailed report on the implementation of the planned measures and the results achieved.
ilsp.reference: The Commission makes available 50% of the envisaged financial compensation based on an action programme submitted by the Government of Guinea-Bissau and pays the remaining funds as soon as the Government of this country submits a detailed report on the implementation of the planned measures and the results achieved in the process.

ilsp.query: Dazu halte ich es für unerlässlich, verstärkt die Interessengruppen einzubinden. Dazu zählt auch angesichts erheblicher Mängel, die allein im Agrarsektor zum Beispiel durch BSE jetzt ans Tageslicht kamen, eine ansprechende, eine neue Vermarktung des gesunden Lebensmittels und unverzichtbaren Proteinlieferanten Fisch.
ilsp.judge: In addition, I believe it is essential to involve interest groups more. This also includes, in view of significant shortcomings, for example, in the agricultural sector, which have now come to light, such as BSE, an appealing, a new marketing of healthy food and an indispensable protein supplier fish.
ilsp.proxy: I consider it indispensable to involve interest groups more strongly. This also applies, for example, in light of significant flaws that were brought to light in the agricultural sector, such as BSE, by means of a convincing, new marketing of healthy food and an indispensable supplier of fish protein.
ilsp.reference: To this end, I consider it essential to involve interest groups more strongly. This also includes, in light of significant shortcomings that have only recently come to light in the agricultural sector, for example, through BSE, an appealing and new marketing of the healthy food item and indispensable protein supplier, fish.

ilsp.query: Was die Frage der Fischerei und der Globalisierung anbelangt, so muss man zwangsläufig anerkennen, dass das niedrige Niveau der Selbstversorgung der Gemeinschaft mit Fischereiprodukten zu einer viel früheren und stärkeren Liberalisierung des Warenaustauschs als in anderen Sektoren geführt hat, aber die Art der Fischereitätigkeit selbst, die fortschreitende Unterstellung der Fangplätze unter nationale Hoheitsrechte und andere Umstände - die, wenn auch mit vielen Besonderheiten, vergleichbare Wirkungen wie die Globalisierung haben - rufen besonders intensive Auswirkungen im sozialen Bereich hervor, mit manchmal gravierenden Folgen für die Arbeitsbedingungen oder Verlagerungen der mit der Fischerei verbundenen Tätigkeiten.
ilsp.judge: As far as the question of fishing and globalization is concerned, it is inevitable to recognize that the low level of self-sufficiency of the community in fishery products has led to a much earlier and stronger liberalization of the exchange of goods in this sector than in other sectors, but the nature of fishing activity itself, the progressive subordination of fishing grounds to national sovereignty and other circumstances - which, although with many peculiarities, have similar effects to globalization - call for particularly intensive social effects, with sometimes serious consequences for working conditions or relocations of activities related to fishing.
ilsp.proxy: Regarding the question of fishing and globalization, one has to inevitably acknowledge that the low level of self-sufficiency of the community with fishery products led to a much earlier and stronger liberalization of trade exchanges than in other sectors, but the nature of fishing activity itself, the ongoing assumption of fishing grounds under national sovereignty rights and other circumstances - which, although with many particularities, have comparable effects like globalization - evoke particularly intense social impacts, with sometimes grave consequences for working conditions or shifts in activities related to fishing.
ilsp.reference: When it comes to the issue of fishing and globalization, it is inevitable to acknowledge that the low level of community self-sufficiency in fishery products has led to a much earlier and more intense liberalization of trade exchanges in this sector than in other areas, but the nature of fishing activity itself, the progressive subordination of fishing grounds to national sovereignty and other circumstances - which, although with many particularities, have comparable effects to globalization - give rise to particularly intense social impacts, with sometimes severe consequences for working conditions or the relocation of activities related to fishing.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, es ist doch immer wieder beruhigend, bei jeder Fischereidebatte dieselben wenigen Gesichter zu sehen, und ich möchte dem Kommissionsmitglied, den Kollegen und Freunden versichern, dass sie auf uns zählen können, ganz gleich wie spät es wird, denn wir mögen zwar nur eine kleine Gruppe sein, aber wir haben alle ein aktives Interesse an der Fischereiwirtschaft.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, it is always reassuring to see the same few faces at every fishing debate, and I would like to assure the Commissioner, the colleagues and friends that they can count on us, no matter how late it is, because we may be a small group, but we all have an active interest in the fishing industry.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, it is always reassuring to see the same few faces at every fishing debate, and I want to assure the Commission member, colleagues, and friends that we can count on them no matter how late it gets, for although we may be a small group, we all have a keen interest in the fishing industry.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, it's always reassuring to see the same few faces at every fishing debate, and I would like to assure the Commissioner, colleagues, and friends that they can count on us, no matter how late it gets, because we may be a small group, but we all have an active interest in the fishing industry.

ilsp.query: Die von den drei Berichterstattern übereinstimmend genannten Hauptziele dieses Reformprozesses sind ausweislich der Entschließungsanträge folgende: die Überkapazitäten abbauen und die Kohärenz mit umweltpolitischen Maßnahmen verbessern, um die Bestände zu erhalten und wiederherzustellen, die direkt Betroffenen stärker in die Entscheidungen einbinden und lokale oder dringende Probleme effizienter lösen, um die Einhaltung und die Durchsetzung der Regelungen zu sichern und das Fischereimanagement insgesamt zu verbessern, also alles, was unter das Stichwort good governance fällt.
ilsp.judge: The main goals of this reform process, as stated in the resolutions, are to reduce overcapacity and improve coherence with environmental measures to maintain and restore stocks, to involve directly affected parties more in decision-making and to solve local or urgent problems more efficiently, to ensure compliance and enforcement of regulations and to improve fisheries management overall, that is, everything that falls under the heading of good governance.
ilsp.proxy: The main goals of this reform process, as consistently named by the three rapporteurs, are evidenced in the resolutions as follows: reducing excess capacities and enhancing coherence with environmental policy measures to conserve and restore fish stocks, involving directly affected parties more strongly in decision-making, solving local or urgent problems more efficiently, securing and enforcing regulations, and improving overall fisheries management, thus everything that falls under the keyword good governance.
ilsp.reference: The main objectives of this reform process, as unanimously stated by the three rapporteurs, are as follows, according to the draft resolutions: to reduce overcapacity and improve coherence with environmental policy measures in order to maintain and restore the stocks, to more strongly involve the directly affected parties in the decision-making process and to solve local or urgent problems more efficiently in order to ensure compliance with and enforcement of the regulations and to improve fisheries management overall, thus covering everything under the heading of good governance.

ilsp.query: Wir konnten auch die Schwachstellen im politischen Bereich kennen lernen, die ihren Ausdruck in einem äußerst gewalttätigen Klima finden, das die Beziehungen zwischen der Regierung von Frau Hasina Wajed, der Awani-Liga und den Oppositionskräften, insbesondere der Bangladesh National Party (BNP), die im Übrigen nicht regelmäßig an den Arbeiten des Parlaments teilnimmt, kennzeichnet.
ilsp.judge: We could also learn the weaknesses in the political field, which find their expression in an extremely violent climate that characterizes the relations between the government of Mrs. Hasina Wajed, the Awani League and the opposition forces, especially the Bangladesh National Party (BNP), which, incidentally, does not regularly participate in the work of the Parliament.
ilsp.proxy: We also became acquainted with the weaknesses in the political sphere, which find expression in an extremely violent climate that characterizes the relationships between the government under Mrs. Hasina Wajed, the Awami League, and opposition forces, particularly the Bangladesh National Party (BNP), which, incidentally, does not regularly participate in the parliamentary works.
ilsp.reference: We were also able to learn about the weaknesses in the political sphere, which found their expression in an extremely violent climate that characterizes the relationships between the government of Prime Minister Hasina Wajed, the Awami League, and the opposition forces, particularly the Bangladesh National Party (BNP), which, incidentally, does not regularly participate in the work of the parliament.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, ich gehöre wie andere in diesem Saal zu der glücklichen Gruppe von Leuten, die Bangladesch besucht haben, nicht mehrfach, wie der Kommissar, aber ich konnte mir einen kleinen Eindruck verschaffen. Und vor diesem Hintergrund möchte ich betonen, dass es wichtig ist, die Zusammenarbeit zwischen der EU und Bangladesch fortzuführen und weiterzuentwickeln.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, I belong, like others in this chamber, to the lucky group of people who have visited Bangladesh, not multiple times, like the Commissioner, but I was able to get a small impression. And in this context, I would like to stress that it is important to continue and further develop the cooperation between the EU and Bangladesh.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, I belong to the happy group of people who visited Bangladesh, not multiple times like the Commissioner, but I was still able to gain a small impression. ilsp.query: Dabei haben Bangladesch und die anderen Länder in dieser Kategorie die Chance, sich nicht als schwerkranker Patient zu präsentieren, der vom Rest der Welt neugierig betrachtet wird, sondern als Partner in einer globalen Gesellschaft mit Kulturen und Potenzialen, die für die Aufrechterhaltung der Vielfalt der Globalisierung wichtig sind.
ilsp.judge: In this category, Bangladesh and other countries have the opportunity to present themselves not as a seriously ill patient who is being watched by the rest of the world, but as a partner in a global society with cultures and potentials that are important for the maintenance of the diversity of globalization.
ilsp.proxy: In doing so, Bangladesh and the other countries in this category have the chance not to present themselves as sick patients scrutinized curiously by the rest of the world, but as partners in a global society with cultures and potentials that are crucial for maintaining the diversity of globalization.
ilsp.reference: In this context, Bangladesh and other countries in this category have the chance to present themselves not as a severely ill patient being curiously observed by the rest of the world, but as partners in a global society with cultures and potentials that are important for maintaining the diversity of globalization.

ilsp.query: Da die Debatte zudem öffentlich ist und von einer konsternierten europäischen Öffentlichkeit verfolgt wird, sind wir meines Erachtens folglich alle verpflichtet, den Hohen Vertreter der Gemeinsamen Außen- und Sicherheitspolitik der Europäischen Union, der bis vor kurzem NATO-Generalsekretär war und gegen den nach Aussage der Staatsanwältin in der Zeitung "La Repubblica " und anderenorts eine Untersuchung des Internationalen Gerichtshofs in Den Haag wegen einer Klage aufgrund von Verbrechen gegen die Menschlichkeit anhängig ist, aufzufordern, uns - damit man uns nicht der Mittäterschaft beschuldigen kann - darzulegen, wie er als Generalsekretär der NATO einem "Mini "Atomkrieg auf dem Balkan zustimmen konnte.
ilsp.judge: As the debate is also public and is being followed by a stunned European public, we are all, in my opinion, obliged to call on the High Representative of the Common Foreign and Security Policy of the European Union, who was recently the NATO Secretary General, and against whom, according to the prosecutor's statement in the newspaper "La Repubblica" and elsewhere, an investigation by the International Criminal Court in The Hague is pending due to a complaint for crimes against humanity, to explain to us - so that we cannot be accused of being accomplices - how he as Secretary General of NATO could agree to a "mini" nuclear war in th
ilsp.proxy: Since the debate is also public and being watched by a shocked European public, we are, in my opinion, all obliged to request that the High Representative of the European Union's Common Foreign and Security Policy, who until recently was the NATO Secretary-General and against whom, according to the statement of the prosecutor in the newspaper "La Repubblica" and elsewhere, an investigation by the International Court of Justice in The Hague is pending due to a complaint of crimes against humanity, explain how, as NATO Secretary-General, he could have agreed to a "mini" nuclear war on the Balkans.

ilsp.query: Die NATO hat nur tröpfchenweise Informationen weitergegeben; als Beispiel möchte ich lediglich anführen, dass die Arbeitsgruppe des Umweltprogramms der Vereinten Nationen Ende 1999 festgestellt hat, dass sie nicht über ausreichende Informationen zur Beurteilung des Ausmaßes der Verseuchung des Kosovo durch abgereichertes Uran verfügt.
ilsp.judge: The NATO has only drip-fed information; as an example, I would only like to point out that the working group of the United Nations Environment Programme found at the end of 1999 that it did not have sufficient information to assess the extent of the pollution of Kosovo by depleted uranium.
ilsp.proxy: The NATO has only provided点滴信息；例如，我只想指出，联合国环境规划署的工作组在1999年底得出结论，他们没有足够的信息来评估科索沃因浓缩铀污染的程度。

ilsp.query: Diese Fälle haben bei Medizinern, Wissenschaftlern, Militärs und Politikern und deshalb auch in der Öffentlichkeit dieser Länder die berechtigte Sorge geweckt, dass es möglicherweise einen - wie ich betonen möchte, nicht bewiesenen - Zusammenhang zwischen der Strahleneinwirkung von abgereichertem Uran, das in der benutzten Munition enthalten ist, und dem Ausbruch der genannten Krankheiten gibt.
ilsp.judge: These cases have raised legitimate concern among doctors, scientists, military personnel, and politicians, and therefore also in the public of these countries, that there may be a - as I emphasize, not proven - connection between the radiation exposure of depleted uranium, which is contained in the ammunition used, and the outbreak of the aforementioned diseases.
ilsp.proxy: These cases have raised justified concern among physicians, scientists, military personnel, and politicians, and thus also in the public of these countries, that there may be - as I would like to emphasize, an unproven - connection between the exposure to enriched uranium radiation, which is contained in depleted ammunition, and the outbreak of the aforementioned diseases.

ilsp.query: Ich möchte in diesem Zusammenhang noch einen anderen Fall erwähnen. Ich habe mit großer Sorge gelesen, dass im Auftrag des britischen Verteidigungsministeriums Munition mit abgereichertem Uran auch in der Irischen See im Solway Firth zwischen England und Schottland sowie auf einem Schießstand an der Küste von Cumbria nur sieben Meilen von einem britischen Atomkraftwerk entfernt verschossen wurde.
ilsp.judge: I would like to mention another case in this context. I have read with great concern that ammunition with depleted uranium was fired in the Irish Sea in the Solway Firth between England and Scotland and on a firing range on the coast of Cumbria only seven miles from a British nuclear power plant at the request of the British Ministry of Defence.

ilsp.query: Deshalb ist es richtig, alle wissenschaftlichen Untersuchungen, die zur Klärung der Auswirkungen dieser Geschosse auf Gesundheit und Umwelt notwendig sind, durchzuführen und zu koordinieren, und gleichzeitig auch das mehr denn je angebrachte Vorsorgeprinzip anzuwenden, weshalb das Moratorium eine dringende und unerlässliche Maßnahme ist.
ilsp.judge: Therefore, it is right to carry out and coordinate all scientific studies necessary to clarify the effects of these bullets on health and the environment, and at the same time to apply the precautionary principle, which is more than ever appropriate, which is why the moratorium is an urgent and indispensable measure.
ilsp.proxy: Therefore, it is correct to conduct and coordinate all scientific investigations necessary for clarifying the impacts of these projectiles on health and the environment, and to apply the well-justified precautionary principle simultaneously, which makes the moratorium a urgent and indispensable measure.

ilsp.query: Ich bin hier nur der Vertreter eines kleinen Landes, kann Ihnen jedoch versichern, dass gerade Österreich mit seiner langen Tradition der Neutralität und Bündnisfreiheit auf dem Gebiet der politischen Vermittlungstätigkeit und Krisenintervention eine große Erfahrung hat und von den Konfliktpartnern entsprechend akzeptiert wird.
ilsp.judge: I am here only as the representative of a small country, but I can assure you that Austria, with its long tradition of neutrality and non-alignment, has a great experience in the field of political mediation and crisis intervention and is accordingly accepted by the conflict parties.
ilsp.proxy: I am merely the representative of a small country, but I can assure you that Austria, with its long tradition of neutrality and freedom of alliance in the field of political mediation and crisis intervention, has extensive experience and is accepted accordingly by the conflict parties.
ilsp.reference: I am here only as the representative of a small country, but I can assure you that Austria, with its long tradition of neutrality and non-alignment, has a great deal of experience in the field of political mediation and crisis intervention, and is accordingly accepted by the conflict partners.

ilsp.query: Verehrte Abgeordnete! Während des vom 25. bis 27. November letzten Jahres im Rahmen des politischen Dialogs stattgefundenen Gipfeltreffens in Pjöngjang hob die europäische Troika die wichtigsten Punkte der Handlungsleitlinien der Europäischen Union gegenüber der Demokratischen Volksrepublik Korea hervor - und zwar der auf den Ratstagungen am 9. Oktober und 20. November angenommenen Handlungsleitlinien.

ilsp.query: Dazu gehören zum Beispiel die Achtung der Menschenrechte, die Nichtverbreitung von Kernwaffen, der Zugang der Bevölkerung zu externen Hilfsmaßnahmen, bessere Arbeitsbedingungen für die NRO - ein Thema, das ich letzten Sommer bei meinem Treffen mit dem Außenminister Nordkoreas in Bangkok erörtert habe - sowie die Öffnung der nordkoreanischen Wirtschaft und die dafür notwendige Strukturreform.
ilsp.judge: For example, it includes respect for human rights, the non-proliferation of nuclear weapons, access of the population to external relief measures, better working conditions for the NRO - a topic that I discussed last summer at my meeting with the North Korean Foreign Minister in Bangkok - as well as the opening of the North Korean economy and the necessary structural reform.

ilsp.query: Artikel 6 Absatz 4 der Richtlinie 92/43/EWG besagt doch: "Ist trotz negativer Ergebnisse der Verträglichkeitsprüfung aus zwingenden Gründen des überwiegenden öffentlichen Interesses einschließlich sozialer oder wirtschaftlicher Art ein Plan oder Projekt durchzuführen, und ist eine Alternativlösung nicht vorhanden, so ergreift der Mitgliedstaat alle notwendigen Ausgleichsmaßnahmen, um sicherzustellen, dass die globale Kohärenz von Natura 2000 geschützt ist.
ilsp.judge: Article 6(4) of Directive 92/43/EEC says: "If, despite negative results of the compatibility check, a plan or project is to be carried out for overriding reasons of public interest including social or economic ones, and an alternative solution is not available, the Member State shall take the necessary compensatory measures to ensure that the overall coherence of Natura 2000 is protected.
ilsp.proxy: Article 6 Paragraph 4 of Directive 92/43/EEC states: "If, despite negative results from the compatibility assessment, it is necessary for overriding public interest reasons, including social or economic ones, to implement a plan or project, and if an alternative solution is not available, the Member State shall take all necessary compensatory measures to ensure that the overall coherence of Natura 2000 is protected."
ilsp.reference: Article 6, paragraph 4 of Directive 92/43/EEC states: "If, despite negative results of the compatibility assessment, a plan or project is to be carried out for compelling reasons of overriding public interest, including social or economic considerations, and an alternative solution is not available, the Member State shall take all necessary compensatory measures to ensure that the global coherence of Natura 2000 is protected."

ilsp.query: Daraus geht eindeutig hervor, zu wessen Gunsten hier die "Engpässe in der Infrastruktur ", insbesondere in den "Verkehrs- und Energieinfrastrukturen " beseitigt, das "Finanzsystem effizient " gestaltet oder "transparente und demokratische institutionelle Rahmenbedingungen " geschaffen werden sollen, ein Euphemismus, mit dem man sich angesichts der allgegenwärtigen Korruption gegen sämtliche Beeinträchtigungen der westlichen Investoren wendet.
ilsp.judge: It is clear from this that the "bottlenecks in the infrastructure", especially in the "transport and energy infrastructure", should be eliminated, the "financial system should be efficient" or "transparent and democratic institutional framework" should be created, a euphemism for which one turns to all the obstacles to Western investors in the face of widespread corruption.
ilsp.proxy: It is clear that the removal of "constraints in infrastructure," particularly in "transport and energy infrastructure," the "efficient shaping of the financial system," or the creation of "transparent and democratic institutional frameworks" is intended for the benefit of someone, an euphemism used to shield against all disruptions to Western investors in the face of pervasive corruption.
ilsp.reference: It is clearly evident here whose interests are being served by eliminating the "bottlenecks in the infrastructure," particularly in the "traffic and energy infrastructures," by making the "financial system efficient" or by creating "transparent and democratic institutional frameworks," a euphemism used to address all the obstacles faced by Western investors in the face of ubiquitous corruption.

ilsp.query: Was den Wunsch nach Verzicht auf eine geographische Begrenzung für diese schnelle Eingreiftruppe anbelangt, so erinnert dies an die Raubzüge der früheren Kolonialmächte in Afrika und anderswo, wie sie etwa von Frankreich begangen wurden, um vom Volk abgelehnte Diktatoren zu schützen, oder wie sie derzeit von Großbritannien in Sierra Leone durchgeführt werden.
ilsp.judge: As for the desire to waive the geographical limitation for this rapid response force, this reminds us of the raids of the former colonial powers in Africa and elsewhere, such as those committed by France to protect dictators rejected by the people, or as they are currently being carried out by Britain in Sierra Leone.
ilsp.proxy: Regarding the desire to forgo a geographical limitation for this rapid reaction force, this reminds us of the plundering expeditions of former colonial powers in Africa and elsewhere, such as those carried out by France to protect despotic leaders rejected by the people, or as they are currently conducted by the United Kingdom in Sierra Leone.

ilsp.query: Der Vorschlag für eine Verordnung zur Schaffung der Sonderfazilität für Kriseneinsätze ist nichts anderes als der Rahmen für zwar nichtmilitärische, aber nichtsdestoweniger imperialistische politische und wirtschaftliche Interventionen in jedem beliebigen Teil der Welt. Was die führenden Kreise der EU anstreben, ist ein Mechanismus zur sofortigen Mobilisierung von Human- und Finanzressourcen, der rasch eingesetzt werden kann, und zwar nicht nur in "Krisensituationen " (vielleicht könnten uns die Verfasser des Textes einmal sagen, welche Merkmale eine "Krisensituation " kennzeichnen), sondern auch dann, wenn lediglich eine Bedrohung oder selbst nur eine Beeinträchtigung der so genannten Unterstützungs- und Kooperationsprogramme mit diesen Ländern zu befürchten ist.
ilsp.judge: The proposal for a regulation to create the special facility for crisis operations is nothing more than the framework for non-military, but nonetheless imperialist political and economic interventions in any part of the world. What the leading circles of the EU are seeking is a mechanism for the immediate mobilization of human and financial resources that can be quickly deployed, not only in "crisis situations" (perhaps the authors of the text could tell us once what characteristics a "crisis situation" has), but also when only a threat or even a disruption of the so-called support and cooperation programs with these countries is to be feared.

ilsp.query: Was seit der reichlich hysterischen Aufbauschung dieser Krise in den meisten unserer Mitgliedstaaten geschieht, trägt sicher nicht dazu bei, junge Menschen zu motivieren, in der Landwirtschaft zu bleiben und erst recht nicht, im ländlichen Raum ihre Zukunft zu sehen, wo sie, wie es in unserem Bericht so schön steht, eine wichtige soziale Funktion zu erfüllen haben, indem sie sich der Landschaftspflege und -erhaltung widmen und zur Deckung des wirtschaftlichen, sozialen und ökologischen Bedarfs des ländlichen Raums beitragen.
ilsp.judge: What has been happening since the rather hysterical exaggeration of this crisis in most of our Member States certainly does not motivate young people to stay in agriculture and even less to see their future in rural areas, where, as our report so beautifully says, they have an important social function to fulfill by devoting themselves to landscape conservation and contributing to the economic, social and ecological needs of rural areas.
ilsp.proxy: What has happened since the rather hysterical hype of this crisis in most of our member states certainly does not contribute to motivating young people to stay in agriculture, let alone see their future in rural areas, where, as our report beautifully states, they have an important social function to fulfill by dedicating themselves to landscape conservation and contributing to the economic, social, and ecological needs of the countryside.
ilsp.reference: What has been happening since the over-the-top dramatization of this crisis in most of our member states certainly does not contribute to motivating young people to stay in agriculture and even less to seeing their future in rural areas, where, as our report so aptly puts it, they have an important social function to fulfill by devoting themselves to landscape care and conservation and contributing to meeting the economic, social, and ecological needs of rural areas.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, ich habe zwar für diesen Bericht über die Gemeinsame Fischereipolitik gestimmt, doch fordere ich das Europäische Parlament, den Rat und die Kommission auf, einen unter Ziffer 20 des Berichts gehörenden, jedoch vergessenen Aspekt stärker im Auge zu haben und zu überwachen, nämlich auf welche Art und Weise bzw. ob überhaupt Rentenbetrag, -höhe und -bedingungen im Fischereisektor, und insbesondere der Rentner im Bereich der handwerklichen Fischerei, kontrolliert werden.
ilsp.judge: Mr President, I voted for this report on the Common Fisheries Policy, but I call on the European Parliament, the Council and the Commission to pay more attention to and monitor a point under paragraph 20 of the report, which is missing, namely how and whether pensions are controlled in terms of amount, conditions and terms in the fisheries sector, and in particular for pensioners in the artisanal fisheries sector.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, although I voted for this report on the Common Fisheries Policy, I urge the European Parliament, the Council, and the Commission to pay more attention to and monitor an aspect that is mentioned under point 20 of the report but has been overlooked, namely how, or even if at all, pension amounts, levels, and conditions in the fisheries sector, and particularly among pensioners in the artisanal fishing sector, are controlled.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, I have indeed voted in favor of this report on the Common Fisheries Policy, but I call on the European Parliament, the Council, and the Commission to pay closer attention to and monitor a particular aspect mentioned under point 20 of the report, which has been overlooked, namely how, or indeed whether, pension amounts, levels, and conditions are controlled in the fishing sector, and particularly for pensioners in the artisanal fishing industry.

ilsp.query: Da die Gemeinschaft gemäß der einschlägigen Erklärung in Artikel 5 Absatz 1 des Anhangs IX des Internationalen Seerechtsübereinkommens allein für die Erhaltung und Bewirtschaftung der Fischbestände zuständig und damit befugt ist, die entsprechenden Regeln und Bestimmungen festzulegen, sollte die Kommission von dieser Befugnis Gebrauch machen und das ausschließliche Fangrecht auch für die griechischen Fischer auf 12 Seemeilen festlegen.
ilsp.judge: Since the Community is responsible for the conservation and management of fish stocks in accordance with the relevant provisions of Article 5(1) of Annex IX to the International Convention for the Conservation of the Living Resources of the High Seas, the Commission should exercise this competence and set the exclusive fishing right also for Greek fishermen at 12 nautical miles.
ilsp.proxy: Since the Community, according to the relevant statement in Article 5(1) of Annex IX to the International Convention for the Regulation of Whaling, is alone responsible for the conservation and management of fish stocks and thus entitled to determine the corresponding rules and regulations, the Commission should make use of this entitlement and establish the exclusive fishing right also for Greek fishermen at 12 nautical miles.
ilsp.reference: In accordance with the relevant declaration in Article 5, paragraph 1 of Annex IX to the International Convention on the Law of the Sea, the community is responsible and authorized for the conservation and management of fish stocks, and thus entitled to establish the corresponding rules and regulations. The Commission should exercise this authority and also set the exclusive fishing right to 12 nautical miles for Greek fishermen.

ilsp.query: Bis zum 31. Dezember 2002 bleiben uns noch zwei Jahre, in denen wir über eine gemeinsame Politik nachdenken und beschließen können. Laut Aufstellung der Europäischen Kommission stellen sich in diesem Zusammenhang 18 Fragen, wie freier oder nicht freier Zugang zu den Gemeinschaftsgewässern, Kontrolle oder Management des Marktes für Fischerei- und Aquakulturerzeugnisse, internationale Fischereiabkommen, wissenschaftliche Forschungstätigkeit in Bezug auf die Fischbestände, Besonderheiten des Mittelmeerraums.
ilsp.judge: We have two years left until December 31, 2002, in which we can think and decide on a common policy. ilsp.query: Der gemeinsame Entschließungsantrag zum "Balkan-Syndrom " dient lediglich dazu, die kriminelle Politik der NATO und der Europäischen Union zu bemänteln, die unter dem Vorwand, die Menschenrechte verteidigen zu wollen, in Jugoslawien interveniert haben und dadurch irreparable menschliche und materielle Schäden verursacht haben.
ilsp.judge: The joint resolution on the "Balkan Syndrome" is only intended to cover up the criminal policy of NATO and the European Union, which have intervened in Yugoslavia under the pretext of wanting to defend human rights and thereby caused irreparable human and material damage.
ilsp.proxy: The common resolution proposal on the "Balkan Syndrome" merely serves to cloak the criminal policy of NATO and the European Union, which intervened in Yugoslavia under the pretext of wanting to defend human rights and thereby caused irreparable human and material damage.
ilsp.reference: The joint resolution motion on the "Balkan Syndrome" serves merely to whitewash the criminal policy of NATO and the European Union, which intervened in Yugoslavia under the pretext of wanting to defend human rights and thereby caused irreparable human and material damage.

ilsp.judge: The use of this weapon type by the United States and other NATO countries during the Gulf War, in Bosnia and in Kosovo has already caused the death of many soldiers, suffering and deaths among the inhabitants of the bombed areas and the pollution of the environment in the affected regions.

ilsp.query: Abgesehen davon spricht der Entschließungsantrag kurz überaus ernste Fragen im Zusammenhang mit der Analyse und der notwendigen Erforschung von abgereichertem Uran an, geht aber an keiner Stelle auf die fortgesetzten Bemühungen ein, Tatsachen, unabhängige, uns allen bekannte Forschungsarbeiten, ja sogar wissenschaftliche Abhandlungen aus NATO-Ländern zu verschleiern und zu verheimlichen, die die Gefährlichkeit von abgereichertem Uran nachweisen und Vorsorgemaßnahmen nennen, die diese Länder ihren Streitkräften auferlegen.
ilsp.judge: Apart from that, the resolution briefly addresses extremely serious questions in connection with the analysis and the necessary research of enriched uranium, but does not go into the continued efforts to conceal facts, independent, well-known research, even scientific papers from NATO countries, which prove the danger of enriched uranium and recommend preventive measures that these countries impose on their armed forces.
ilsp.proxy: Apart from that, the resolution motion briefly touches on extremely serious issues related to the analysis and necessary research of enriched uranium, but nowhere addresses the ongoing efforts to conceal and hide facts, independent research works known to all of us, and even scientific papers from NATO countries that demonstrate the danger of enriched uranium and preventive measures that these countries impose on their armed forces.
ilsp.reference: Apart from that, the resolution proposal briefly addresses extremely serious questions related to the analysis and necessary research of depleted uranium, but it does not address the continued efforts to conceal and cover up facts, independent and well-known research works, yes, even scientific papers from NATO countries, which demonstrate the danger of depleted uranium and recommend preventive measures that these countries impose on their armed forces.

ilsp.query: Wir sehen mit großer Sorge, dass es, auch durch das Handeln des Generalsekretariats des Ministerrats - und Herr Solana, den ich hoch schätze, kümmert sich ja mehr um die Aufgabe des Hohen Vertreters - an der Spitze des Generalsekretariats des Ministerrats manche Abschottungen gibt, dass man weder der Kommission noch dem Europäischen Parlament Informationen geben will.
ilsp.judge: We see with great concern that, also through the action of the General Secretariat of the Council - and Mr. Solana, whom I highly value, is indeed more concerned with the task of the High Representative - at the head of the General Secretariat of the Council, some closures are given, that one does not want to give information to the Commission or to the European Parliament.
ilsp.proxy: We see with great concern that, despite the actions of the General Secretariat of the Council - and I highly esteem Mr. Solana, who indeed takes more interest in the task of the High Representative - there are some isolations at the top of the General Secretariat of the Council, where neither the Commission nor the European Parliament is willing to share information.
ilsp.reference: We see with great concern that, even through the actions of the Council Secretariat - and Mr. Solana, whom I highly esteem, is indeed more concerned with the task of the High Representative - there are some exclusions at the top of the Council Secretariat, that one does not want to give information to either the Commission or the European Parliament.

ilsp.query: Erstens, wird der schwedische Ratsvorsitz einen Rat oder eine Sondersitzung einberufen, zu der die Regierungsvertreter der Beitrittsländer eingeladen werden, um einerseits die Verhandlungen voranzubringen und andererseits das wichtige Signal für die Öffentlichkeit zu setzen, dass die Erweiterung nicht nur ein politisches Ziel, eine Fata Morgana, ein noch immer fernes Ziel ist, sondern dass wir auch tatsächlich die notwendigen Fortschritte erreichen?
ilsp.judge: First, the Swedish presidency will convene a Council or a special session to which the government representatives of the accession countries will be invited, in order to advance the negotiations on the one hand and to send the important signal to the public that the enlargement is not only a political goal, a Fata Morgana, a still distant goal, but that we are also actually achieving the necessary progress?
ilsp.proxy: Firstly, the Swedish presidency will convene a council or extraordinary session at which representatives of the candidate countries will be invited, in order to advance the negotiations on the one hand and, on the other hand, to send an important signal to the public that enlargement is not just a political goal, a mirage, still a distant objective, but that we are actually making the necessary progress?

ilsp.query: Der von mir bereits erwähnte Beschluss besagt, dass ein Bürger eines EU-Mitgliedstaates, der sich um konsularische Hilfe an eine diplomatische oder konsularische Vertretung eines anderen Mitgliedstaates wendet, so zu behandeln ist, als wäre er Bürger des Landes, das durch die betreffende Botschaft oder das Konsulat vertreten wird.
ilsp.judge: The decision mentioned above states that a citizen of an EU Member State who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular mission of another Member State is to be treated as if he were a citizen of the country represented by the relevant embassy or consulate.
ilsp.proxy: The resolution I have already mentioned states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular representation of another member state should be treated as if they were a citizen of the country represented by the embassy or consulate.
ilsp.reference: The decision I mentioned earlier states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular representation of another member state is to be treated as if they were a citizen of the country represented by the relevant embassy or consulate.

ilsp.query: Ich möchte den Ratsvorsitzenden Folgendes fragen: Wird die schwedische Präsidentschaft nach dieser Tragödie, die wir erlebt haben und die offiziell mindestens 60 Menschen das Leben gekostet hat, sowie angesichts der Folterungen, des Schicksals von Menschen, die vielleicht nur deshalb im Gefängnis sitzen, weil sie ihre Muttersprache gesprochen haben, und des Hungerstreiks, in dem sich noch immer etwa 200 Häftlinge befinden, öffentlich irgendeine Initiative ergreifen, wird sie Erklärungen und Zusagen von der türkischen Regierung verlangen? Und wird sich die schwedische Präsidentschaft endlich für die Freilassung der Abgeordneten Leyla Zana einsetzen, der von diesem Parlament der Sacharow-Preis verliehen worden ist?
ilsp.judge: I would like to ask the chair: Will the Swedish presidency take any initiative publicly in the wake of this tragedy that we have experienced and which has officially cost the lives of at least 60 people, in the face of the torture, the fate of people who may only be in prison because they spoke their mother tongue, and the hunger strike in which about 200 inmates are still involved, will it demand explanations and assurances from the Turkish government? And will the Swedish presidency finally campaign for the release of Leyla Zana, a member of this parliament who has been awarded the Sakharov Prize?
ilsp.proxy: I would like to ask the Council President: Will the Swedish presidency take any public initiative after this tragedy, which has officially cost at least 60 lives, as well as considering the torture, the fate of people who might be in prison merely because they spoke their mother tongue, and the hunger strike in which around 200 prisoners are still participating? And will the Swedish presidency finally advocate for the release of Deputy Leyla Zana, who was awarded the Sakharov Prize by this parliament?
ilsp.reference: I would like to ask the chairperson the following: Will the Swedish presidency, in light of this tragedy that we have experienced and which has officially cost the lives of at least 60 people, as well as in light of the torture, the fate of people who may only be in prison because they spoke their mother tongue, and the hunger strike in which approximately 200 inmates are still participating, take any public initiative? Will it demand explanations and promises from the Turkish government? And will the Swedish presidency finally advocate for the release of MP Leyla Zana, who was awarded the Sakharov Prize by this parliament?

ilsp.query: Der Rat begrüßt außerdem die Tatsache, dass sich die EU und die ASEAN in ihrer in Vientiane beschlossenen gemeinsamen Erklärung verpflichten, die Bemühungen des Sonderbeauftragten des UNO-Generalsekretärs für Birma, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, um eine positive Entwicklung in Burma zu unterstützen.
ilsp.judge: The Council also welcomes the fact that the EU and ASEAN have committed themselves in their joint statement adopted in Vientiane to support the efforts of the Special Envoy of the UN Secretary-General for Burma, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, to promote a positive development in Burma.
ilsp.proxy: The Council also welcomes that the EU and the ASEAN have committed themselves in their joint declaration adopted in Vientiane to support the efforts of the Special Adviser of the UN Secretary-General for Myanmar, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, to promote a positive development in Myanmar.
ilsp.reference: The Council also welcomes the fact that the EU and ASEAN have committed themselves in their joint statement adopted in Vientiane to supporting the efforts of the UN Secretary-General's Special Envoy for Myanmar, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, to promote a positive development in Myanmar.

ilsp.query: Abschließend noch eine letzte kritische Anmerkung: 1994 hat Aung San Suu Kyi Gespräche mit dem SLORC, wie der SPDC sich damals nannte, geführt und dabei wurde ihr vorgeworfen, sie sei viel zu unflexibel und man könne nicht mit ihr zusammenarbeiten, weil sie nicht von ihrer Forderung nach der Anerkennung der Wahlen von 1990 durch den SLORC abweiche.
ilsp.judge: Finally, one last critical note: In 1994, Aung San Suu Kyi held talks with the SLORC, as the SPDC was then called, and she was accused of being too inflexible and that one could not work with her because she did not deviate from her demand for the recognition of the 1990 elections by the SLORC.

Mai 2001 Zeit zu geben, um eine Einigung zu erreichen, auf deren Grundlage dann der Text des neuen Abschnitts Q erstellt werden soll.

ilsp.judge: Although there are no complete and 100% secure findings yet, but at least we recognize the seriousness of the situation and wonder if we should not ask the Commission in this case by a motion for amendment - otherwise we would choose another way - to take certain measures in this field.
ilsp.proxy: Although we do not yet have complete and 100 percent certain insights into this matter, we at least recognize the severity of the situation and wonder whether we should ask the Commission in this case to take certain measures on this issue through a proposal for a motion - otherwise, we would choose another path.
ilsp.reference: While there are as yet no complete and 100-percent secure findings on the matter, we at least acknowledge the gravity of the situation and wonder whether we should not request the commission, by way of a motion to amend - otherwise we would choose a different path - to take certain measures in this regard.

ilsp.query: Meines Erachtens wird hierdurch deutlich, dass die Verkehrssicherheit nicht mit herausgegriffenen Einzelmaßnahmen im erforderlichen Maße erhöht werden kann, sondern dass dies nur durch einen ganzen Komplex von Maßnahmen machbar ist, und dazu gehören Verkehrserziehung, Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzung, Alkoholbegrenzung, besserer Straßenausbau, Verkehrsleitsysteme, erhöhter Sicherheitsstandard der Fahrzeuge, stärkere Kontrollen der Einhaltung der Straßenverkehrsordnung und auch eine permanente Begutachtung der Fahrzeuge, die sich im Straßenverkehr befinden.
ilsp.judge: In my opinion, it is clear that traffic safety cannot be increased to the required extent by isolated individual measures, but only by a whole complex of measures, and these include traffic education, speed limit, alcohol limit, better road construction, traffic control systems, increased safety standards of vehicles, stricter enforcement of traffic regulations and also a permanent assessment of the vehicles that are in traffic.
ilsp.proxy: In my opinion, it becomes clear here that traffic safety cannot be increased sufficiently through makeshift individual measures alone, but can only be achieved through a comprehensive range of measures, which include traffic education, speed limits, alcohol limits, better road infrastructure, traffic control systems, higher vehicle safety standards, stronger enforcement of traffic regulations, and also continuous inspection of vehicles in circulation.
ilsp.reference: In my opinion, it becomes clear that road safety cannot be increased to the required extent by isolated individual measures, but rather that this can only be achieved through a comprehensive set of measures, including traffic education, speed limits, alcohol restrictions, improved road infrastructure, traffic management systems, enhanced vehicle safety standards, stricter enforcement of traffic regulations, and also a permanent inspection of vehicles that are in operation on the roads.

ilsp.query: Außerdem können auch andere, in dem Bericht erwähnte Vorschläge, wie die stärkere Unterstützung des europäischen Programms zur Bewertung von Neufahrzeugen, die Förderung von Kampagnen zugunsten der Verwendung von Sicherheitsgurten, die Entwicklung von Telematiksystemen sowie der obligatorische Einbau von Tagesfahrlichtern in Motorrädern und Fahrzeugen, relativ kostengünstig mit hohem Nutzen für die Straßenverkehrssicherheit und die Volksgesundheit verwirklicht werden.
ilsp.judge: In addition, other proposals mentioned in the report, such as the stronger support of the European program for the evaluation of new vehicles, the promotion of campaigns in favor of the use of seat belts, the development of telematics systems as well as the mandatory installation of daytime running lights in motorcycles and vehicles, can be implemented relatively cost-effectively with high benefit for road safety and public health.

ilsp.query: Damit will ich sagen, dass wir es keinesfalls abgelehnt haben, Vorschriften in Bezug auf Frontkonstruktionen, die für Menschen, für ungeschützte Körper weniger gefährlich sind, auszuarbeiten, sondern wir wollen einfach noch effektiver sein, indem wir die Unterstützung des Automobilsektors gewinnen.
ilsp.judge: I mean to say that we have by no means rejected the drafting of regulations on front structures that are less dangerous for people, for unprotected bodies, but we simply want to be more effective by winning the support of the automotive sector.
ilsp.proxy: With that, I want to say that we have not at any point rejected the idea of developing regulations concerning front designs that are less dangerous for people, especially unprotected bodies, but we simply want to be more effective by gaining the support of the automotive sector.

ilsp.query: Deshalb sollte sich das Präsidium mit dieser wichtigen Angelegenheit befassen, und ich möchte anfragen, ob es darüber informiert ist und ob es bei den Straßburger Behörden wegen zusätzlicher Maßnahmen zum Schutz des Parlaments vorstellig geworden ist. Wenn ich es richtig sehe, hat fast jedermann Zutritt zum Parlament, und ich befürchte, wir haben uns auf überaus gefährliche und unvorhersehbare Ereignisse einzustellen.
ilsp.judge: Therefore, the Bureau should deal with this important matter, and I would like to ask whether it is informed about this and whether it has approached the Strasbourg authorities for additional measures to protect the Parliament. If I am not mistaken, almost everyone has access to the Parliament, and I fear that we are preparing for extremely dangerous and unpredictable events.

ilsp.query: In unserer Stellungnahme wollten wir die gesamte Herstellungskette der Forstwirtschaft einschließlich der Waldpflege und Holzgewinnung sowie der Bedeutung von Rentabilität der Forstwirtschaft als Rohstoffgrundlage herausstellen, gründet sich doch eine nachhaltige europäische Forstwirtschaft nach wie vor auf die sogenannte "Familienwirtschaft " von zwölf Millionen privaten Waldbesitzern und ihrer Tätigkeit.
ilsp.judge: In our statement, we wanted to highlight the entire production chain of the forestry industry, including forest management and timber harvesting, as well as the importance of the profitability of the forestry industry as a raw material basis, as a sustainable European forestry is still based on the so-called "family farming" of twelve million private forest owners and their activities.
ilsp.proxy: In our statement, we aimed to highlight the entire forestry production chain, including forest management and timber harvesting, as well as the significance of the profitability of private forest owners and their activities as the foundation for a sustainable European forestry sector.

ilsp.query: Der Berichterstatter freut sich über die grundsätzliche Übereinstimmung in den im Bericht enthaltenen grundlegenden Prinzipien, nämlich darin, dass es in die Zuständigkeit der Gemeinschaft fällt, eine gemeinsame Methodik zur Berechnung der Kosten des Verkehrs zu entwickeln; dass externe Kosten in eine solche Bewertung einfließen sollten; dass die Einnahmen für die Verringerung von Umweltschäden und die Förderung des Übergangs zu umweltschonenderen Verkehrsträgern zu verwenden seien; dass die Umsetzung vom Prinzip der Subsidiarität bestimmt sein sollte; dass die Nutzer und Verursacher in Abhängigkeit von der Benutzung zahlen und dass Ausnahmen für die weniger mobilen Mitglieder der Gesellschaft und die Bewohner ländlicher Gebiete gelten sollten.
ilsp.judge: The rapporteur is pleased with the general agreement on the basic principles contained in the report, namely that it falls within the competence of the Community to develop a common methodology for calculating the costs of transport; that external costs should be included in such an assessment; that revenues for reducing environmental damage and promoting the transition to more environmentally friendly modes of transport should be used; that implementation should be determined by the principle of subsidiarity; that users and polluters should pay in proportion to their use, and that exceptions should apply to the less mobile members of society and the inhabitants of rural areas.

ilsp.judge: Mr. Posselt, even if it really would be an enrichment if you spoke for 20 minutes - I could then also speak for 20 minutes, because no one else from our faction is there anymore - it would indeed be the case that the work that the colleague Deprez has carried out very carefully here could not be discussed to the extent that it would be appropriate.

ilsp.query: Vor allem für die Angehörigen der Opfer ist es nämlich unerträglich, dass noch keiner der Kommandeure der Roten Khmer für die von ihnen verübten Verbrechen bestraft worden ist und die Hauptschuldigen am Genozid völlig unbehelligt in Kambodscha leben, ganz zu schweigen von der Beteiligung ehemaliger Roter Khmer an der Regierung.
ilsp.judge: Especially for the relatives of the victims, it is unbearable that none of the commanders of the Khmer Rouge has been punished for the crimes they committed and that the main culprits of the genocide are living completely unharmed in Cambodia, not to mention the involvement of former Khmer Rouge in the government.
ilsp.proxy: Es ist besonders für die relatives der Opfer unerträglich, dass bis heute keiner der Kommandeure der Roten Khmer für die von ihnen begangenen Verbrechen verantwortlich gemacht wurde und die Hauptverantwortlichen am Genozid in Kambodscha ungestraft leben, geschweige denn, dass ehemalige Roter Khmer an der Regierung beteiligt waren.
ilsp.reference: Above all, it is unbearable for the relatives of the victims that none of the commanders of the Khmer Rouge have been punished for the crimes they committed, and that the main perpetrators of the genocide are completely unharmed and living in Cambodia, not to mention the involvement of former Khmer Rouge members in the government.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, die Älteren unter uns haben die außergewöhnlichen, grauenhaften Berichte, die 1975 aus Kambodscha kamen, noch nicht vergessen. Es gab Luftaufnahmen von einer verlassenen Hauptstadt, weil die Roten Khmer, deren Anführer nach den Lehrsätzen der Gewalt in der Tradition der französischen Revolution geschult wurden und von einer Mischung aus politischem Idealismus und Massenpsychopathologie erfüllt waren, zwei Millionen Menschen von der Stadt auf das Land umsiedelten, um unter der Führung des "großen " Pol Pot im Jahre Null mit einer neuen Gesellschaft zu beginnen.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, the elders among us have not forgotten the extraordinary, horrifying reports that came out of Cambodia in 1975. There were aerial photographs of an abandoned capital city because the Red Khmer, whose leader was trained in the teachings of violence in the tradition of the French Revolution and was filled with a mixture of political idealism and mass psychopathology, relocated two million people from the city to the countryside to begin a new society under the leadership of "great" Pol Pot in the year zero.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, those of us who are older have not yet forgotten the extraordinary and horrific reports that came from Cambodia in 1975. ilsp.query: Georgien wird heute buchstäblich durch seinen großen Nachbarn erstickt; das Land wird mit Öl­, Gas- und Stromlieferungen sowie mit Visavorschriften erpresst und ist dieser unglaublichen Diskriminierung zwischen den Bürgern Südossetiens und Abchasiens einerseits und den übrigen georgischen Bürgern andererseits ausgesetzt.
ilsp.judge: Georgia is literally suffocated by its big neighbor today; the country is extorted with oil, gas and electricity supplies and with visa restrictions and is exposed to this incredible discrimination between the citizens of South Ossetia and Abkhazia on the one hand and the rest of the Georgian citizens on the other hand.

ilsp.query: Wir warten vergebens auf den einzigen geeigneten Vorschlag, um die gesamte Region zu stabilisieren, um vor die Tore Tschetscheniens zu gelangen, um der russischen Umklammerung dieser Region ein Ende zu setzen, den einzigen seriösen Vorschlag, der darin bestünde, dass Georgien offiziell vorgeschlagen wird, der Europäischen Union beizutreten.
ilsp.judge: We are waiting in vain for the only appropriate proposal to stabilize the entire region in order to reach the gates of Chechnya in order to put an end to the Russian encirclement of this region, the only serious proposal that would consist of Georgia officially being proposed to join the European Union.
ilsp.proxy: We wait in vain for the single appropriate proposal to stabilize the entire region, to reach the gates of Chechnya, to put an end to Russia's stranglehold on this region, the only serious proposal that Georgia should officially be suggested to join the European Union.

ilsp.query: Der einseitig eingeführte Visumzwang für Georgien, mit Ausklammerung von zwei Gebieten, die Georgien unterstellt sind, bringt neue Spaltpilze in ein Land, das dem Europarat angehört, das sich demokratisch entwickeln will und mit dem wir ein Abkommen geschlossen haben, um sie eben in all ihren Bereichen zu unterstützen.
ilsp.judge: The unilateral visa requirement for Georgia, excluding two areas that Georgia is subordinate to, brings new rifts to a country that belongs to the Council of Europe, which wants to develop democratically and with which we have signed an agreement to support them in all their areas.
ilsp.proxy: The one-sided introduction of a visa requirement for Georgia, with two areas exempted that Georgia considers its own, introduces new divisionary fungi into a country that belongs to the Council of Europe, which wishes to develop democratically and with which we have concluded an agreement to support it in all areas.
ilsp.reference: The one-sided introduction of a visa requirement for Georgia, excluding two regions that are under Georgia's jurisdiction, brings new divisions to a country that belongs to the Council of Europe, which wants to develop democratically and with whom we have signed an agreement to support them in all areas.

lsp.query: Die Europäische Union hat schon jetzt ihre Solidarität unter Beweis gestellt, indem sie eine Hilfsmannschaft vor Ort geschickt hat, während die Bereitstellung von Finanzhilfen der EU und ihrer Mitgliedstaaten bereits erfolgte oder in Kürze erfolgen wird. Ich kann Ihnen mitteilen, dass einige Fraktionen unseres Parlaments gefordert haben, die Frage im Rahmen der Dringlichkeitsdebatte am Donnerstag zu behandeln.

lsp.judge: I would like to ask the President to convey our concern over this incident to the Government in Ankara, as well as our hope that this unfortunate incident will not affect the solution of the Cyprus problem and the resumed peace talks, as we also hope that Mr. Tsiakourmas will be released as soon as possible.

Offensichtlich fühlt er sich weitaus stärker als je zuvor, nachdem die Europäische Union die Türkei ohne langes Nachdenken, wie ich meine, in den Kreis der EU-Beitrittskandidaten aufgenommen hat.
lsp.judge: In addition, Mr. Denktasch, the leader of "North Cyprus", which is - just to remind you - under Turkish occupation, rejects participating in further talks to solve the Cyprus problem. lsp.judge: In the report by Mrs Peijs - to which I would like to congratulate her on behalf of the Commission, while I would like to join the compliments of Mrs Villiers and Mr Skinner - which is largely positive on the Common Position, several amendments to Article 20 are proposed - as was mentioned this evening.

lsp.query: Wir begrüßen deshalb die in Lissabon vorgelegten Vorschläge für bessere Regelungen, bei denen die Kosten der Rechtsvorschriften berücksichtigt werden; wir begrüßen das informelle Treffen der Minister für öffentliche Verwaltung am 7. November in Straßburg; wir begrüßen die Schaffung einer hochrangigen Gruppe zur Prüfung der Empfehlungen zur kostengünstigeren Gestaltung der Rechtsvorschriften; wir sind jedoch enttäuscht, dass der zugesagte Vertreter des Europäischen Parlaments in diesem Gremium weder vom Parlament ernannt worden ist noch man, soweit mir bekannt ist, an uns herangetreten ist, einen solchen Vertreter zu ernennen.
lsp.judge: We therefore welcome the proposals put forward in Lisbon for better rules that take into account the costs of the regulations; we welcome the informal meeting of Ministers for Public Administration on 7 November in Strasbourg; we welcome the creation of a high-level group to review the recommendations for the cost-effective design of regulations; we are however disappointed that the promised representative of the European Parliament in this group has neither been appointed by the Parliament nor, as far as I know, approached us to appoint such a representative.
lsp.proxy: We therefore welcome the proposals presented in Lisbon for better regulation, taking into account the costs of legislation; we welcome the informal meeting of Ministers for Public Administration on 7 November in Strasbourg; we welcome the creation of a high-level group to examine the recommendations for making legislation more cost-effective; however, we are disappointed that the European Parliament's representative, as promised, has neither been appointed by the Parliament nor, to my knowledge, has approached us to appoint such a representative.
lsp.reference: We therefore welcome the proposals put forward in Lisbon for better regulations that take into account the costs of the legal provisions; we welcome the informal meeting of the ministers for public administration on 7 November in Strasbourg; we welcome the creation of a high-level group to examine the recommendations for a more cost-effective design of the legal provisions; however, we are disappointed that the promised representative of the European Parliament has neither been appointed by the Parliament nor, as far as I am aware, approached us to appoint such a representative.
