ilsp.query: Ich denke, dass der Bericht, die Art und Weise des Abschlusses, von dem ich hoffe, dass er endgültig ist und es nicht zu einem neuen Wirbel um das Entlastungsinstrument kommt, uns nun ermöglicht, nach vorn zu blicken und diese Entlastung, die von unserem Parlament lange abgewogen worden ist und die zu Reaktionen von Seiten der Kommission geführt hat, in gewisser Weise als Musterbeispiel zu betrachten.
ilsp.judge: I think that the report, the way it is concluded, I hope it is final and that it does not lead to a new storm around the relief instrument, now allows us to look forward and consider this relief, which has been weighed by our Parliament for a long time and which has led to reactions from the Commission, in a way as an example.
ilsp.proxy: I think that the report, the way it was concluded, which I hope is final and that there will be no new fuss about the relief instrument, now allows us to look forward and to consider this relief, which has been long weighed by our Parliament and which has led to reactions from the Commission, in a way as a model example.
ilsp.reference: I think that the report, the manner of its conclusion, which I hope is final and does not lead to a new commotion around the relief instrument, now allows us to look forward and in a certain sense consider this relief, which has been weighed for a long time by our parliament and has led to reactions from the Commission, as a model example.

ilsp.query: Der Rechnungshof erinnert uns daran, dass bei zwingend vorgeschriebenen Sicherheitsleistungen der Grundsatz gilt, dass sie von den Zollbehörden in einer Höhe festzusetzen sind, die dem genauen Betrag der Zollschuld entspricht, sofern dieser Betrag zweifelsfrei ermittelt werden kann, oder andernfalls dem von den Zollbehörden geschätzten höchstmöglichen Betrag der Zollschuld, die entstanden ist oder entstehen kann.
ilsp.judge: The Court of Auditors reminds us that the principle applies that they must be set by the customs authorities at an amount that corresponds to the exact amount of the customs debt, provided that this amount can be determined with certainty, or otherwise at the highest possible amount of the customs debt that has arisen or may arise.
ilsp.proxy: The Federal Audit Office reminds us that in the case of mandatory security requirements, the principle applies that they must be set by the customs authorities at an amount that corresponds to the exact amount of the customs duty, if this amount can be determined without a doubt, or otherwise at the highest possible amount of customs duty estimated by the customs authorities that has arisen or may arise.
ilsp.reference: The Court of Auditors reminds us that in the case of mandatory security measures, the principle applies that they must be set by the customs authorities at a level corresponding to the exact amount of the customs debt, provided that this amount can be determined with certainty, or otherwise at the highest estimated amount of the customs debt that has arisen or may arise.

ilsp.query: Erwiesenermaßen war es richtig, das Büro in Thessaloniki zu belassen, denn hätten wir es nach Pristina ausgelagert, hätte Jugoslawien heute keinerlei Aussicht auf eine finanzielle Unterstützung durch die Agentur für Wiederaufbau, denn kein Serbe könnte jemals nach Pristina reisen, um dort auch nur einen Euro einzufordern.
ilsp.judge: It was undoubtedly right to leave the office in Thessaloniki, because if we had relocated it to Pristina, Yugoslavia would have no prospect of financial support from the Agency for Reconstruction today, because no Serb could ever travel to Pristina to claim even a euro there.
ilsp.proxy: It was proven right to keep the office in Thessaloniki, because if we had moved it to Pristina, Yugoslavia would have no chance of receiving financial support from the Reconstruction Agency, because no Serb could ever travel to Pristina to claim even one euro.
ilsp.reference: It was undoubtedly the right decision to leave the office in Thessaloniki, because if we had relocated it to Pristina, Yugoslavia would have no prospect of financial support from the Reconstruction Agency, since no Serb could ever travel to Pristina to claim even a single euro.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident! Trotz der Mittel, die seit Jahren über die Strukturfonds für die Förderung des territorialen Gleichgewichts in der Europäischen Union eingesetzt werden, ist das Pro-Kopf-Einkommen der 25 reichsten Regionen immer noch zweieinhalb Mal höher als das der ärmsten, und trotz der vielen Bedürfnisse dieser strukturschwachen Regionen werden Jahr für Jahr nicht alle Mittel ausgeschöpft, die im Haushalt für die Entwicklung vorgesehen sind.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President! Despite the funds that have been used for the promotion of territorial balance in the European Union for years through the structural funds, the per capita income of the 25 richest regions is still twice as high as that of the poorest, and despite the many needs of these structurally weak regions, not all funds intended for development are used every year.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President! Despite the funds that have been used for years through the Structural Funds to promote territorial balance in the European Union, the per capita income of the 25 richest regions is still twice and a half times higher than that of the poorest, and despite the many needs of these structurally weak regions, not all the funds earmarked for development in the budget are used up year after year.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President! Despite the funds that have been invested in the structural funds for the promotion of territorial balance in the European Union for years, the per capita income of the 25 richest regions is still two and a half times higher than that of the poorest, and despite the many needs of these structurally weak regions, not all the funds allocated in the budget for development are being utilized year after year.

ilsp.query: Die tiefgreifende politische Umgestaltung der Strukturen der bundesdeutschen Regierung ist ein deutliches Signal dafür, dass es selbst im Herzen Europas, wo die GAP entworfen wurde und wo sie stets ihre große Stütze fand, immer unhaltbarer ist, ein Modell einer Agrarpolitik aufrecht zu erhalten, das zur Bewahrung des industriellen Systems und der großen landwirtschaftlichen Betriebe konzipiert wurde.
ilsp.judge: The deep political restructuring of the structures of the German government is a clear signal that it is even more untenable in the heart of Europe, where the CAP was designed and where it has always found its great support, to maintain a model of agricultural policy designed to preserve the industrial system and large agricultural enterprises.
ilsp.proxy: The profound political reshaping of the structures of the German government is a clear signal that even in the heart of Europe, where the CAP was designed and where it has always found its strong support, it is becoming increasingly unsustainable to maintain a model of agricultural policy designed to preserve the industrial system and large agricultural enterprises.
ilsp.reference: The far-reaching political restructuring of the federal government's structures is a clear indication that even at the heart of Europe, where the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) was designed and where it has always found its strong support, it is becoming increasingly unsustainable to maintain a model of agricultural policy that was conceived to preserve the industrial system and large-scale agricultural enterprises.

ilsp.query: Wir können nicht hinnehmen, dass Unternehmen, die in den Genuss von europäischen Beihilfen gekommen sind, wenn sie sich finanziell gesund gestoßen haben, aus Gründen der Strukturanpassung die Entlassung tausender Arbeitnehmer beschließen und damit deren Familien in eine Notlage bringen, zu deren Unterstützung dann wieder nationale und europäische öffentliche Gelder in Anspruch genommen werden.
ilsp.judge: We cannot accept that companies that have benefited from European subsidies when they have recovered financially, decide to lay off thousands of workers for reasons of structural adjustment and thus bring their families into a state of need, to which national and European public funds are then taken into use for their support.
ilsp.proxy: We cannot accept that companies that have benefited from European subsidies, when they were already financially healthy, decide to lay off thousands of employees for structural adjustment reasons and thus bring their families into financial hardship, for which national and European public funds are then again required.
ilsp.reference: We cannot accept that companies that have benefited from European subsidies, having financially recovered, decide to lay off thousands of employees for reasons of structural adjustment and thereby bring their families into a state of emergency, only to then again draw on national and European public funds for their support.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident! Als Abgeordneter aus jenem Teil Irlands, der sowohl vom IFI als auch vom Fonds für Frieden und Versöhnung profitiert, möchte ich die bisher erzielten Erfolge beider Instrumente hervorheben, und als Abgeordneter, der eng mit lokalen Gruppen und Projekten zusammenarbeitet, die diese Fonds in ausgezeichneter Weise nutzen, möchte ich feststellen, dass ich völlig davon überzeugt bin, dass über alle durch die Fonds ausgereichten Gelder exakt Buch geführt wird.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President! As a Member from that part of Ireland which has benefited from both the IFI and the Peace and Reconciliation Fund, I would like to highlight the successes achieved to date by both instruments, and as a Member who works closely with local groups and projects which are using these Funds to great effect, I am completely convinced that every cent of money provided by the Funds is accounted for.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President! As a Member of Parliament from that part of Ireland that has benefited from both the IFI and the Peace and Reconciliation Fund, I would like to highlight the successes achieved so far by both instruments. And as a Member of Parliament who works closely with local groups and projects that use these funds in an excellent way, I want to state that I am completely convinced that exact accounts are kept of all the funds disbursed by the funds.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President! As a Member of Parliament from that part of Ireland which benefits from both the IFI and the Fund for Peace and Reconciliation, I would like to highlight the achievements of both instruments to date, and as a Member of Parliament who closely works with local groups and projects that make excellent use of these funds, I am completely convinced that every single euro disbursed by the funds is accounted for.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, sehr geehrte Damen und Herren Abgeordnete! Ich möchte zunächst den Herren Garriga, McCartin, Staes und Dell'Alba für die Berichte zu den insgesamt 10 Berichten des Rechnungshofs danken, die den Zeitraum 1999/2000 umfassen, bzw. dazu veröffentlicht worden sind.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, Honourable Members! I would first like to thank the gentlemen Garriga, McCartin, Staes and Dell'Alba for the reports on the 10 reports of the Court of Auditors covering the period 1999/2000, respectively, which have been published.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, honourable ladies and gentlemen Members! I would like to thank Messrs. Garriga, McCartin, Staes and Dell'Alba for the reports on the ten reports of the Court of Auditors, which cover the period 1999/2000 and have been published accordingly.
ilsp.reference: Honorable President, esteemed Members of Parliament! I would like to thank Messrs. Garriga, McCartin, Staes and Dell'Alba for the reports on the total of 10 Court of Auditors' reports, which cover the period 1999/2000, and have been published accordingly.

ilsp.query: Die Europäische Zentralbank hat auf den Bericht geantwortet, aber ihre Antworten fielen sehr kurz aus, ich würde sagen kurz und knapp, und der Rechnungshof hielt diese für nicht ausreichend, da sie keinerlei Hinweise darauf enthielten, welche Schritte die EZB einzuleiten gedenkt, um die im Bericht des Rechnungshofs aufgedeckten Unzulänglichkeiten abzustellen.
ilsp.judge: The European Central Bank responded to the report, but their responses were very short, I would say short and sweet, and the Court of Auditors considered these to be insufficient, as they contained no indication of the steps the ECB intends to take to remedy the shortcomings revealed in the Court of Auditors' report.
ilsp.proxy: The European Central Bank responded to the report, but their answers were very short, I would say short and to the point, and the Court of Auditors considered them insufficient because they did not contain any indication of what steps the ECB intends to take to remedy the shortcomings uncovered in the Court of Auditors' report.
ilsp.reference: The European Central Bank responded to the report, but their answers were very brief, I would say brief and to the point, and the Court of Auditors deemed them insufficient, as they contained no indication of the steps the ECB intends to take to address the shortcomings revealed in the Court of Auditors' report.

ilsp.query: Wir müssen begreifen, dass die Zeiten, in denen ein Arbeitsplatz ein ganzes Leben lang hielt, heute vorbei sind; dass neue Arbeitsmöglichkeiten erdacht werden müssen und dass der KMU- und der Handwerkssektor unseren Jugendlichen und den Unionsbürgern in Zukunft immer mehr reale Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten bieten werden.
ilsp.judge: We must understand that the times when a job held a whole life are over today; that new job opportunities must be invented and that the SME and the crafts sector will offer our young people and Union citizens in the future more and more real employment opportunities.
ilsp.proxy: We must understand that the times when a job lasted a lifetime are over today; that new job opportunities must be conceived and that the SME and crafts sector will offer our young people and Union citizens more real employment opportunities in the future.
ilsp.reference: We must understand that the times when a job would last a whole lifetime are over; that new job opportunities need to be created and that the SME and crafts sector will offer our young people and Union citizens more and more real job opportunities in the future.

ilsp.query: Wenn sich aber - und das sollte durchaus festgeschrieben werden - nach 18 Monaten bzw. nach zwei Jahren eine Bewertung als notwendig erweist und diese Bewertung ausweist, dass den Grenzarbeitnehmern unzumutbare Nachteile entstehen, dann muss die Möglichkeit bestehen, und diesen Punkt möchte ich in den Bericht aufgenommen sehen, eine andere Entscheidung zu treffen.
ilsp.judge: However, if - and this should be clearly stated - after 18 months or two years, an assessment is deemed necessary and this assessment shows that the border workers are suffering from unbearable disadvantages, then the possibility must exist, and I would like to see this point included in the report, to make a different decision.
ilsp.proxy: But if - and this should certainly be enshrined - after 18 months or two years an assessment proves necessary and this assessment shows that border workers are facing unacceptable disadvantages, then the possibility must exist, and I would like to see this point included in the report, to make a different decision.
ilsp.reference: However, and this should be clearly stated - if an evaluation becomes necessary after 18 months or two years, and this evaluation shows that frontier workers are suffering unacceptable disadvantages, then there must be the possibility, and I would like to see this point included in the report, of making a different decision.

ilsp.query: (ES) Meine Zustimmung zum Bericht de Veyrac über die Umsetzung des Übereinkommens zum Schutz des Kultur- und Naturerbes der Welt in den Staaten der Europäischen Union basiert auf der Überzeugung, dass es notwendig ist, die kulturelle Dimension der Europäischen Union weiterzuentwickeln und eine Kulturpolitik in der Union zu gewährleisten, die als eines der Hauptmerkmale ihres geistigen Reichtums und des Alten Kontinents die kulturelle, sprachliche, architektonische und künstlerische Vielfalt sowie alle jene Elemente zum Tragen bringt, die unser gemeinsames kulturelles Erbe darstellen.
ilsp.judge: (ES) My approval of the Veyrac report on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of the World Cultural and Natural Heritage in the States of the European Union is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a cultural policy in the Union that is one of the main characteristics of its spiritual wealth and the old continent, bringing together the cultural, linguistic, architectural and artistic diversity and all those elements that represent our common cultural heritage.
ilsp.proxy: My consent to the de Veyrac report on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of the World Cultural and Natural Heritage in the European Union member states is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a cultural policy in the Union that, as one of the main features of its intellectual wealth and of the Old Continent, brings to bear the cultural, linguistic, architectural and artistic diversity as well as all those elements that constitute our common cultural heritage.
ilsp.reference: My consent to the report by de Veyrac on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of the World's Cultural and Natural Heritage in the Member States of the European Union is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a cultural policy in the Union that, as one of the main characteristics of its spiritual wealth and the Old Continent, encompasses the cultural, linguistic, architectural, and artistic diversity, as well as all those elements that represent our shared cultural heritage.

ilsp.query: Es hat wenig genutzt, dass wir im Namen des Schutzes der Volksgesundheit das Verbot von PCB und die Dekontamination aller PCB und PCT enthaltenden Geräte beschlossen haben, wenn nach fünf Jahren die überwiegende Mehrheit der Mitgliedstaaten die Richtlinie nicht nur nicht umsetzt, sondern nicht einmal das getan hat, was am einfachsten wäre: die PCB-Bestandsaufnahme und Pläne zur Dekontamination.
ilsp.judge: It has done little good that we have decided in the name of the protection of public health to ban PCBs and to decontaminate all PCB and PCT-containing equipment, if after five years the majority of Member States not only do not implement the Directive, but do not even do what would be the easiest: the PCB inventory and plans for decontamination.
ilsp.proxy: It has been of little use that we decided to ban PCBs and decontaminate all devices containing PCBs and PCTs in the name of protecting public health, if after five years the vast majority of member states not only do not implement the directive, but have not even done the simplest thing: the PCB inventory and plans for decontamination.
ilsp.reference: It has made little difference that we decided on the ban of PCB and the decontamination of all devices containing PCB and PCT in the name of protecting public health, if after five years the overwhelming majority of member states have not only not implemented the directive, but have not even done what would be the easiest thing: conducting a PCB inventory and drawing up plans for decontamination.

ilsp.query: In Zeiten, da die neuen Generationen erkennen, dass die Lebensqualität nicht mehr eng mit der Industrialisierung, den Städten und den großen Handelszentren verbunden ist, sind wir in der Union verpflichtet, den Generationswechsel zu unterstützen und zu fördern. Dieser Kreislauf im Leben der Menschen muss in der Landwirtschaft mit neuen Gemeinschaftsinitiativen einhergehen, in deren Mittelpunkt der Junglandwirt steht.
ilsp.judge: In times when the new generations recognize that quality of life is no longer linked to industrialization, cities and major trading centers, we in the Union are obliged to support and promote the generational change. This cycle in the life of people must go hand in hand with new community initiatives in agriculture, with the young farmer at the center.
ilsp.proxy: In times when new generations are recognizing that quality of life is no longer closely linked to industrialization, cities, and large trading centers, we in the Union are obligated to support and promote generational change. This life cycle of people must go hand in hand with new community initiatives in agriculture, with the young farmer at its center.
ilsp.reference: In times when the new generations recognize that the quality of life is no longer closely tied to industrialization, cities, and major trade centers, we in the Union are committed to supporting and promoting the generational change. This cycle in human life must go hand in hand with new community initiatives in agriculture, with the young farmer at its center.

ilsp.query: Bei diesen Faktoren handelt es sich erstens um die GAP, die vor allem nach 1992 und mit der Agenda 2000 eine Form angenommen hat, die den meisten landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben mittlerer Größe in der Gemeinschaft nicht das zum Überleben notwendige Einkommen garantiert, die den Haushaltsvorständen nicht den nötigen Lebensunterhalt sichert. Deshalb werden in einem Sektor wie der Landwirtschaft, die nicht nur keine Gewinne erwirtschaftet, sondern noch nicht einmal ein Mindesteinkommen gewährleistet, trotz der vielen Beihilfen - so viele sind es aber nun auch wieder nicht ­ nur wenige Investitionen, selbst in geringer Höhe, getätigt.
ilsp.judge: First of all, it is the GAP, which has taken the form of the CAP since 1992 and with the Agenda 2000, which does not guarantee the necessary income for most medium-sized agricultural holdings in the Community, which does not secure the necessary living for the household heads. Therefore, in a sector such as agriculture, which not only does not make profits, but does not even guarantee a minimum income, despite the many subsidies - there are not so many of them, however - only a few investments, even of a small amount, are made.
ilsp.proxy: These factors first of all include the GAP, which, especially after 1992 and with Agenda 2000, has taken a form that does not guarantee the income necessary for survival to most medium-sized agricultural businesses in the Community, nor does it secure the necessary livelihood for household heads. Therefore, in a sector like agriculture, which not only generates no profits but does not even guarantee a minimum income, despite the many subsidies - although there aren't that many anymore - only few investments, even in small amounts, are made.
ilsp.reference: It is primarily the CAP that is involved here, which, especially after 1992 and with the Agenda 2000, has taken on a form that does not guarantee the necessary income for the survival of most medium-sized agricultural businesses in the community, nor does it secure the necessary living expenses for the household heads. Therefore, in a sector like agriculture, which not only fails to generate profits but also does not even ensure a minimum income, despite the many subsidies - and there are not that many, after all - only a few investments, even of a small scale, have been made.

ilsp.query: Der Bericht unterstreicht die Notwendigkeit von Maßnahmen zur Förderung von Berufsanfängern und der unionsweiten Standardisierung. Wie der Berichterstatter feststellte, setzte sich auch der ausgezeichnete STOA-Bericht, der zu Beginn des vergangenen Jahres vorgelegt worden war, mit dieser Thematik auseinander.
ilsp.judge: The report highlights the need for measures to promote new entrants and cross-border standardization. As the rapporteur pointed out, the excellent STOA report, which was presented at the beginning of last year, also dealt with this issue.
ilsp.proxy: The report underscores the need for measures to promote young professionals and union-wide standardization. As the rapporteur noted, the excellent STOA report, which was presented at the beginning of last year, also dealt with this issue.
ilsp.reference: The report highlights the need for measures to support new entrants to the workforce and for EU-wide standardization. As the rapporteur noted, the excellent STOA report, which was presented at the beginning of last year, also dealt with this issue.

ilsp.query: Diese Umweltschützer sind immer noch in Haft und da das Parlament bei der Wahrung der Interessen der Bewohner von Campo de Gibraltar und der Bucht von Algeciras - um es einmal so zu sagen - wenig Sensibilität gezeigt hat, bitte ich darum, dass man wenigstens geeignete Maßnahmen ergreift, damit diese pazifistischen Umweltschützer zu Hause schlafen können.
ilsp.judge: These environmentalists are still in custody and since the Parliament has shown little sensitivity in safeguarding the interests of the residents of Campo de Gibraltar and the Bay of Algeciras - to put it that way - I ask that at least appropriate measures be taken so that these pacifist environmentalists can sleep at home.
ilsp.proxy: These environmental activists are still in custody, and since the Parliament has shown little sensitivity, so to speak, in upholding the interests of the residents of Campo de Gibraltar and the Bay of Algeciras, I request that at least appropriate measures be taken so that these pacifist environmental activists can sleep at home.
ilsp.reference: These environmental activists are still in custody and since the parliament has shown little sensitivity in safeguarding the interests of the residents of Campo de Gibraltar and the Bay of Algeciras - to put it that way - I kindly request that at least appropriate measures be taken so that these pacifist environmental activists can sleep at home.

ilsp.query: Ich bekräftige erneut meine Forderung, wie ich es in der Vergangenheit so häufig getan habe, dass zur Gewährleistung einer angemessenen Dezentralisierungspolitik der Zugang zu den Küstengewässern innerhalb der 12-Meilen-Zone weiterhin ausschließlich den Anrainerstaaten vorbehalten bleiben muss und dass diese ausschließliche Fischereizone auf 24 Seemeilen ausgedehnt wird, wie es dieses Haus im Februar 1999 gefordert hat.
ilsp.judge: I reiterate my demand, as I have so often done in the past, that in order to ensure an appropriate decentralization policy, access to coastal waters within the 12-mile zone must remain exclusively for coastal states and that this exclusive fishing zone is extended to 24 nautical miles, as this House demanded in February 1999.
ilsp.proxy: I reiterate my demand, as I have done so often in the past, that access to coastal waters within the 12-mile zone should continue to be reserved exclusively for riparian states to ensure an appropriate decentralization policy, and that this exclusive fishing zone be extended to 24 nautical miles, as this House demanded in February 1999.
ilsp.reference: I reiterate my demand, as I have done so frequently in the past, that to ensure an appropriate policy of decentralization, access to coastal waters within the 12-mile zone must remain exclusively reserved for coastal states and that this exclusive fishing zone be extended to 24 nautical miles, as this House demanded in February 1999.

ilsp.query: Die Vertreter der einen möchten das gesamte System mit allen seinen Grundlagen der bisherigen und gegenwärtigen gemeinsamen Fischereipolitik auf den Prüfstand stellen, während die anderen, ohne seine Grundlagen grundsätzlich in Frage zu stellen, das System präzisieren, verändern, verbessern wollen, damit der Fischereisektor sich, natürlich im Einklang und unter Erhalt der Fischereiressourcen, weiter entwickelt.
ilsp.judge: The representatives of one want to put the entire system with all its foundations of the current and current common fisheries policy on the test bench, while the others, without questioning its foundations fundamentally, want to refine, change, improve the system so that the fishing sector can develop further, of course in harmony and under the preservation of the fishing resources.
ilsp.proxy: Representatives of one group want to put the entire system, with all its foundations of past and present common fisheries policy, to the test, while the others, without fundamentally questioning its foundations, want to refine, change, and improve the system so that the fishing sector can continue to develop, of course in harmony and with the preservation of fishing resources.
ilsp.reference: The representatives of one group want to put the entire system, including all its foundations of the current and previous common fisheries policy, to the test, while the others, without fundamentally questioning its foundations, want to refine, change, and improve the system so that the fisheries sector can continue to develop, naturally in harmony and while preserving the fisheries resources.

ilsp.query: Im Einzelnen möchte Ihr Berichterstatter einige Vorschläge hervorheben, insbesondere die Aufrechterhaltung des Status quo bezüglich der 6/12-Meilen-Zone. Weiterhin die Beibehaltung der Schutzzonen nach wissenschaftlichen Gutachten und damit zwangsläufig die Frage des Zugangs zur Nordsee, der angesichts der Erweiterungen konsequenter gehandhabt werden muss.
ilsp.judge: In particular, your rapporteur would like to highlight some proposals, in particular the maintenance of the status quo regarding the 6/12-mile zone. In addition, the maintenance of the protected areas based on scientific assessments and thus inevitably the question of access to the North Sea, which must be handled more consistently in view of the extensions.
ilsp.proxy: In detail, your reporter would like to highlight some proposals, in particular the maintenance of the status quo regarding the 6/12-mile zone. Furthermore, the retention of protection zones based on scientific reports and consequently the question of access to the North Sea, which must be handled more consistently in light of the expansions.
ilsp.reference: In particular, the rapporteur would like to highlight some proposals, especially the maintenance of the status quo regarding the 6/12-mile zone. Furthermore, the retention of protection zones based on scientific assessments, which necessarily raises the question of access to the North Sea, which must be handled more consistently in light of the expansions.

ilsp.query: Wir konnten auch die Schwachstellen im politischen Bereich kennen lernen, die ihren Ausdruck in einem äußerst gewalttätigen Klima finden, das die Beziehungen zwischen der Regierung von Frau Hasina Wajed, der Awani-Liga und den Oppositionskräften, insbesondere der Bangladesh National Party (BNP), die im Übrigen nicht regelmäßig an den Arbeiten des Parlaments teilnimmt, kennzeichnet.
ilsp.judge: We could also learn the weaknesses in the political field, which find their expression in an extremely violent climate that characterizes the relations between the government of Mrs. Hasina Wajed, the Awani League and the opposition forces, especially the Bangladesh National Party (BNP), which, incidentally, does not regularly participate in the work of the Parliament.
ilsp.proxy: We were also able to learn about the weaknesses in the political sphere, which find expression in an extremely violent climate that characterizes the relations between the government of Mrs. Hasina Wajed, the Awami League and the opposition forces, in particular the Bangladesh National Party (BNP), which, by the way, does not regularly participate in the work of parliament.

ilsp.query: Die nordkoreanischen Machthaber sind offenbar bereit zur Öffnung und zum Dialog mit Südkorea, den USA, Europa und Japan. Auch wenn wir sie letztlich nach ihren Taten beurteilen müssen, so bin ich doch überzeugt davon, dass eine europäische Politik des Dialogs, des strukturierten und kritischen Dialogs, in entscheidendem Maße zu einem Wandel in der Demokratische Volksrepublik Korea, der der ganzen Welt zugute kommt, beitragen wird.
ilsp.judge: The North Korean leaders seem to be ready for opening and dialogue with South Korea, the US, Europe and Japan. Even if we ultimately judge them by their deeds, I am convinced that a European policy of dialogue, of structured and critical dialogue, will contribute significantly to a change in the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, which is to the benefit of the whole world.
ilsp.proxy: The North Korean rulers appear to be ready for opening and dialogue with South Korea, the USA, Europe, and Japan. ilsp.query: Nichtsdestotrotz spüre ich eine gewisse Zuversicht und stelle fest, dass die EU-Staaten unkoordiniert angetreten sind - Herr Brok hat soeben davon gesprochen -, um die Anerkennung des stalinistischen Regimes von Pjöngjang zu wetteifern, wobei sie die Augen vor den Geschehnissen innerhalb des Landes, vor den dramatischen Menschenrechtsverletzungen, verschließen.
ilsp.judge: Nevertheless, I feel a certain optimism and find that the EU states have uncoordinated - Mr. Brok has just spoken about it - to compete for the recognition of the Stalinist regime of Pyongyang, while closing their eyes to the events within the country, to the dramatic human rights violations.

ilsp.query: Wenn es lediglich darum gegangen wäre, zu überwachen, dass die EU-Mittel nicht zur Finanzierung von Projekten verwendet werden, die zur Zerstörung dieser besonderen Ökosysteme beitragen, so hätte ich diesen Text akzeptiert und dafür gestimmt, aber es ist inakzeptabel und beispiellos, dass eine Unionspolitik von der Einhaltung einer anderen abhängig gemacht wird und dass ein Umweltkriterium beispielsweise gegenüber einem sozialen Kriterium Vorrang haben soll.
ilsp.judge: If it were merely about monitoring that EU funds are not used to finance projects that contribute to the destruction of these special ecosystems, I would have accepted this text and voted for it, but it is unacceptable and unprecedented that a Union policy is made dependent on compliance with another and that an environmental criterion should have priority over a social criterion, for example.
ilsp.proxy: If it had only been about monitoring that EU funds were not used to finance projects that contribute to the destruction of these special ecosystems, I would have accepted this text and voted for it, but it is unacceptable and unprecedented that Union policy is made dependent on compliance with another, and that an environmental criterion should take precedence over a social criterion, for example.
ilsp.reference: If it had merely been a matter of ensuring that EU funds are not used to finance projects that contribute to the destruction of these unique ecosystems, I would have accepted this text and voted for it, but it is unacceptable and unprecedented that a Union policy is made dependent on the observance of another and that an environmental criterion should take precedence over a social criterion, for example.

ilsp.query: Was den Wunsch nach Verzicht auf eine geographische Begrenzung für diese schnelle Eingreiftruppe anbelangt, so erinnert dies an die Raubzüge der früheren Kolonialmächte in Afrika und anderswo, wie sie etwa von Frankreich begangen wurden, um vom Volk abgelehnte Diktatoren zu schützen, oder wie sie derzeit von Großbritannien in Sierra Leone durchgeführt werden.
ilsp.judge: As for the desire to waive the geographical limitation for this rapid response force, this reminds us of the raids of the former colonial powers in Africa and elsewhere, such as those committed by France to protect dictators rejected by the people, or as they are currently being carried out by Britain in Sierra Leone.
ilsp.proxy: As for the desire to waive a geographical limitation for this rapid reaction force, this recalls the raids of former colonial powers in Africa and elsewhere, such as those carried out by France to protect dictators rejected by the people, or as they are currently being carried out by Britain in Sierra Leone.

ilsp.query: Was seit der reichlich hysterischen Aufbauschung dieser Krise in den meisten unserer Mitgliedstaaten geschieht, trägt sicher nicht dazu bei, junge Menschen zu motivieren, in der Landwirtschaft zu bleiben und erst recht nicht, im ländlichen Raum ihre Zukunft zu sehen, wo sie, wie es in unserem Bericht so schön steht, eine wichtige soziale Funktion zu erfüllen haben, indem sie sich der Landschaftspflege und -erhaltung widmen und zur Deckung des wirtschaftlichen, sozialen und ökologischen Bedarfs des ländlichen Raums beitragen.
ilsp.judge: What has been happening since the rather hysterical exaggeration of this crisis in most of our Member States certainly does not motivate young people to stay in agriculture and even less to see their future in rural areas, where, as our report so beautifully says, they have an important social function to fulfill by devoting themselves to landscape conservation and contributing to the economic, social and ecological needs of rural areas.
ilsp.proxy: What is happening in most of our member states since the rather hysterical build-up of this crisis certainly does not contribute to motivating young people to stay in agriculture and even less so to see their future in the countryside, where, as our report so beautifully puts it, they have an important social function to fulfill by dedicating themselves to landscape care and conservation and contributing to the economic, social and ecological needs of the countryside.
ilsp.reference: What has been happening since the over-the-top dramatization of this crisis in most of our member states certainly does not contribute to motivating young people to stay in agriculture and even less to seeing their future in rural areas, where, as our report so aptly puts it, they have an important social function to fulfill by devoting themselves to landscape care and conservation and contributing to meeting the economic, social, and ecological needs of rural areas.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, ich habe zwar für diesen Bericht über die Gemeinsame Fischereipolitik gestimmt, doch fordere ich das Europäische Parlament, den Rat und die Kommission auf, einen unter Ziffer 20 des Berichts gehörenden, jedoch vergessenen Aspekt stärker im Auge zu haben und zu überwachen, nämlich auf welche Art und Weise bzw. ob überhaupt Rentenbetrag, -höhe und -bedingungen im Fischereisektor, und insbesondere der Rentner im Bereich der handwerklichen Fischerei, kontrolliert werden.
ilsp.judge: Mr President, I voted for this report on the Common Fisheries Policy, but I call on the European Parliament, the Council and the Commission to pay more attention to and monitor a point under paragraph 20 of the report, which is missing, namely how and whether pensions are controlled in terms of amount, conditions and terms in the fisheries sector, and in particular for pensioners in the artisanal fisheries sector.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, although I voted in favour of this report on the Common Fisheries Policy, I call on the European Parliament, the Council and the Commission to pay closer attention to and monitor an aspect belonging to point 20 of the report, which has been overlooked, namely the way in which, or whether at all, pension amount, level and conditions in the fishing sector, and in particular for pensioners in the artisanal fishing sector, are controlled.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, I have indeed voted in favor of this report on the Common Fisheries Policy, but I call on the European Parliament, the Council, and the Commission to pay closer attention to and monitor a particular aspect mentioned under point 20 of the report, which has been overlooked, namely how, or indeed whether, pension amounts, levels, and conditions are controlled in the fishing sector, and particularly for pensioners in the artisanal fishing industry.

ilsp.query: Der Einsatz dieses Waffentyps durch die Vereinigten Staaten und andere NATO-Länder während des Golfkriegs, in Bosnien und im Kosovo hat bereits den Tod vieler Soldaten, Leiden und Todesfälle bei den Bewohnern der bombardierten Gebiete und die Verseuchung der Umwelt in den betroffenen Regionen verursacht.
ilsp.judge: The use of this weapon type by the United States and other NATO countries during the Gulf War, in Bosnia and in Kosovo has already caused the death of many soldiers, suffering and deaths among the inhabitants of the bombed areas and the pollution of the environment in the affected regions.

ilsp.query: (EN) Herr Präsident, meine Damen und Herren. Im Namen meines Kollegen, Herrn Patten, der bereits nach Moskau abgereist ist, möchte ich dem Parlament zur heutigen Aussprache gratulieren, weil sie uns eine wertvolle Gelegenheit zum Meinungsaustausch über die bevorstehende Sitzung der UN-Menschenrechtskommission in Genf bietet.
ilsp.judge: (EN) Mr. President, ladies and gentlemen. In the name of my colleague, Mr. Patten, who has already left for Moscow, I would like to congratulate the Parliament on today's debate, as it offers us a valuable opportunity for an exchange of views on the upcoming session of the UN Human Rights Commission in Geneva.

ilsp.query: Der von mir bereits erwähnte Beschluss besagt, dass ein Bürger eines EU-Mitgliedstaates, der sich um konsularische Hilfe an eine diplomatische oder konsularische Vertretung eines anderen Mitgliedstaates wendet, so zu behandeln ist, als wäre er Bürger des Landes, das durch die betreffende Botschaft oder das Konsulat vertreten wird.
ilsp.judge: The decision mentioned above states that a citizen of an EU Member State who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular mission of another Member State is to be treated as if he were a citizen of the country represented by the relevant embassy or consulate.
ilsp.proxy: The resolution I mentioned earlier states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular representation of another member state shall be treated as if he were a citizen of the country represented by the embassy or consulate in question.
ilsp.reference: The decision I mentioned earlier states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular representation of another member state is to be treated as if they were a citizen of the country represented by the relevant embassy or consulate.

ilsp.query: Der Rat begrüßt außerdem die Tatsache, dass sich die EU und die ASEAN in ihrer in Vientiane beschlossenen gemeinsamen Erklärung verpflichten, die Bemühungen des Sonderbeauftragten des UNO-Generalsekretärs für Birma, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, um eine positive Entwicklung in Burma zu unterstützen.
ilsp.judge: The Council also welcomes the fact that the EU and ASEAN have committed themselves in their joint statement adopted in Vientiane to support the efforts of the Special Envoy of the UN Secretary-General for Burma, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, to promote a positive development in Burma.

ilsp.query: Im Ausschuss für Regionalpolitik, Verkehr und Fremdenverkehr ist man sich jedoch darüber im Klaren, dass die Gewerkschaften und die Luftfahrtunternehmen am besten geeignet sind, um eine Lösung für dieses Problem zu finden, und so haben sich die Mitglieder des Ausschusses in einem Kompromiss darauf geeinigt, allen Beteiligten bis zum 1. Mai 2001 Zeit zu geben, um eine Einigung zu erreichen, auf deren Grundlage dann der Text des neuen Abschnitts Q erstellt werden soll.
ilsp.judge: However, in the Committee on Regional Policy, Transport and Tourism, it is clear that the trade unions and the airlines are best suited to find a solution to this problem, and so the members of the Committee have agreed in a compromise to give all parties until May 1, 2001 to reach an agreement on the basis of which the text of the new section Q will then be prepared.

ilsp.query: Ich spreche hier nicht als Gewerkschafter, sondern als Flugpassagier, der wirklich gern eine wenngleich nicht absolute, so doch größtmögliche Garantie erhalten würde, dass eine übermäßige Beanspruchung des Faktors Mensch, die mitunter fatale Folgen haben kann, vermieden wird.
ilsp.judge: I am not speaking here as a trade unionist, but as a passenger who would really like to receive a guarantee, albeit not absolute, but as great as possible, that excessive strain on the human factor, which can sometimes have fatal consequences, is avoided.
ilsp.proxy: I am speaking here not as a union representative, but as a passenger who would really like to receive a guarantee, albeit not an absolute one, but the greatest possible one, that excessive strain on the human factor, which can sometimes have fatal consequences, will be avoided.
ilsp.reference: I'm speaking here not as a trade unionist, but as a passenger who would very much like to receive, if not an absolute, then at least the greatest possible guarantee that excessive strain on the human factor, which can sometimes have fatal consequences, is avoided.

ilsp.query: Meines Erachtens wird hierdurch deutlich, dass die Verkehrssicherheit nicht mit herausgegriffenen Einzelmaßnahmen im erforderlichen Maße erhöht werden kann, sondern dass dies nur durch einen ganzen Komplex von Maßnahmen machbar ist, und dazu gehören Verkehrserziehung, Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzung, Alkoholbegrenzung, besserer Straßenausbau, Verkehrsleitsysteme, erhöhter Sicherheitsstandard der Fahrzeuge, stärkere Kontrollen der Einhaltung der Straßenverkehrsordnung und auch eine permanente Begutachtung der Fahrzeuge, die sich im Straßenverkehr befinden.
ilsp.judge: In my opinion, it is clear that traffic safety cannot be increased to the required extent by isolated individual measures, but only by a whole complex of measures, and these include traffic education, speed limit, alcohol limit, better road construction, traffic control systems, increased safety standards of vehicles, stricter enforcement of traffic regulations and also a permanent assessment of the vehicles that are in traffic.
ilsp.proxy: In my opinion, this clearly shows that road safety cannot be sufficiently increased by isolated measures, but only by a comprehensive package of measures, which include traffic education, speed limits, alcohol limits, improved road construction, traffic management systems, higher safety standards for vehicles, stricter enforcement of traffic regulations, and also a permanent inspection of vehicles on the road.
ilsp.reference: In my opinion, it becomes clear that road safety cannot be increased to the required extent by isolated individual measures, but rather that this can only be achieved through a comprehensive set of measures, including traffic education, speed limits, alcohol restrictions, improved road infrastructure, traffic management systems, enhanced vehicle safety standards, stricter enforcement of traffic regulations, and also a permanent inspection of vehicles that are in operation on the roads.

ilsp.query: Jene, die darauf setzen, dass die formelle Gleichstellung, der Faktor Zeit und die selbstregulierenden Mechanismen quasi von selbst ein soziales Gleichgewicht herstellen, irren. Sicher sind die Gleichstellung vor dem Gesetz und die Chancengleichheit unerlässliche Voraussetzungen, doch dabei dürfen wir es nicht belassen.
ilsp.judge: Those who bet that formal equality, the factor of time, and the self-regulating mechanisms will almost automatically establish a social equilibrium are mistaken. Of course, equality before the law and equal opportunities are indispensable prerequisites, but we must not stop there.
ilsp.proxy: Those who rely on the formal equality, the factor of time, and self-regulating mechanisms to essentially create a social balance on their own are mistaken.  While equality before the law and equal opportunities are indispensable prerequisites, we must not stop there.
ilsp.reference: Those who believe that formal equality, the factor of time, and self-regulating mechanisms will automatically establish a social equilibrium are mistaken. While legal equality and equal opportunities are essential prerequisites, we must not stop there.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, ich möchte hier den Standpunkt der arbeitenden Frauen darlegen, weil diese unter allen Frauen am meisten unter der Last der sozialen Organisation zu leiden haben und weil die Arbeiterbewegung stolz darauf verweisen kann, als erste für die Anerkennung der Gleichberechtigung von Männern und Frauen eingetreten zu sein.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, I would like to present the position of working women here, because they suffer the most under the burden of social organization and because the labor movement can proudly point out that it was the first to recognize the equality of men and women.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, I would like to present the standpoint of working women here, because they suffer most of all women under the burden of social organization, and because the labor movement can proudly point to itself as the first to advocate for the recognition of equal rights for men and women.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, I would like to present the position of working women here, because they suffer the most under the burden of social organization among all women, and because the labor movement can proudly point out that it was the first to advocate for the recognition of the equality of men and women.

ilsp.query: Der Berichterstatter freut sich über die grundsätzliche Übereinstimmung in den im Bericht enthaltenen grundlegenden Prinzipien, nämlich darin, dass es in die Zuständigkeit der Gemeinschaft fällt, eine gemeinsame Methodik zur Berechnung der Kosten des Verkehrs zu entwickeln; dass externe Kosten in eine solche Bewertung einfließen sollten; dass die Einnahmen für die Verringerung von Umweltschäden und die Förderung des Übergangs zu umweltschonenderen Verkehrsträgern zu verwenden seien; dass die Umsetzung vom Prinzip der Subsidiarität bestimmt sein sollte; dass die Nutzer und Verursacher in Abhängigkeit von der Benutzung zahlen und dass Ausnahmen für die weniger mobilen Mitglieder der Gesellschaft und die Bewohner ländlicher Gebiete gelten sollten.
ilsp.judge: The rapporteur is pleased with the general agreement on the basic principles contained in the report, namely that it falls within the competence of the Community to develop a common methodology for calculating the costs of transport; that external costs should be included in such an assessment; that revenues for reducing environmental damage and promoting the transition to more environmentally friendly modes of transport should be used; that implementation should be determined by the principle of subsidiarity; that users and polluters should pay in proportion to their use, and that exceptions should apply to the less mobile members of society and the inhabitants of rural areas.
ilsp.proxy: The reporter is pleased about the fundamental agreement on the basic principles contained in the report, namely that it is within the competence of the community to develop a common methodology for calculating transport costs; that external costs should be included in such an assessment; that the revenue should be used to reduce environmental damage and promote the transition to more environmentally friendly modes of transport; that the implementation should be determined by the principle of subsidiarity; that users and polluters should pay according to their use; and that exceptions should apply to less mobile members of society and residents of rural areas.
ilsp.reference: The rapporteur welcomes the fundamental agreement on the basic principles contained in the report, namely that it falls within the competence of the community to develop a common methodology for calculating the costs of transport; that external costs should be taken into account in such an assessment; that revenues for reducing environmental damage and promoting a transition to more environmentally friendly modes of transport should be used; that implementation should be determined by the principle of subsidiarity; that users and polluters should pay in proportion to their use; and that exceptions should apply to the less mobile members of society and residents of rural areas.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, die Älteren unter uns haben die außergewöhnlichen, grauenhaften Berichte, die 1975 aus Kambodscha kamen, noch nicht vergessen. Es gab Luftaufnahmen von einer verlassenen Hauptstadt, weil die Roten Khmer, deren Anführer nach den Lehrsätzen der Gewalt in der Tradition der französischen Revolution geschult wurden und von einer Mischung aus politischem Idealismus und Massenpsychopathologie erfüllt waren, zwei Millionen Menschen von der Stadt auf das Land umsiedelten, um unter der Führung des "großen " Pol Pot im Jahre Null mit einer neuen Gesellschaft zu beginnen.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, the elders among us have not forgotten the extraordinary, horrifying reports that came out of Cambodia in 1975. There were aerial photographs of an abandoned capital city because the Red Khmer, whose leader was trained in the teachings of violence in the tradition of the French Revolution and was filled with a mixture of political idealism and mass psychopathology, relocated two million people from the city to the countryside to begin a new society under the leadership of "great" Pol Pot in the year zero.
